title: Cleaning and Waste Cluster Coordinator
description:
Description

Description FIFA has established a Local FIFA Subsidiary in Brazil to work together with FIFA Zurich to deliver the biggest women’s sporting event in the world, the FIFA Women’s World Cup 2027™ ("FWWC2027"), hosted in South America in Brazil. Now is your time to be part of the workforce that is creating this unique and unforgettable experience.

Department: Technical & Infrastructure

Location: Brazil

THE POSITION

The Cleaning and Waste Management Coordinator will support the Senior Cleaning and Waste Management Manager in the planning, operational readiness, implementation, and monitoring of cleaning and waste management operations across FIFA Official Sites. The role supports waste minimisation by reviewing and assessing procurement and service contracts and contributes to achieving defined waste diversion targets.

The position is execution-focused and site-oriented, responsible for supporting readiness planning, coordinating day-to-day operations, and monitoring service delivery during test events and tournament operations. The CLW Coordinator plays a key role in translating strategic and functional requirements into practical, on-the-ground execution, ensuring operational continuity, compliance with FIFA requirements, and the timely identification and resolution of issues at the venue level.

The ideal candidate will combine expertise in event operations, sustainable cleaning, and waste management with strong project management skills. This role will focus on optimizing operational efficiency, ensuring stakeholder satisfaction, and minimizing environmental impact while adhering to FIFA’s stringent standards.

Key Responsibilities

  • Planning & Operational Readiness
  • Support the development and readiness planning of cleaning and waste management operational plans across stadiums and other FIFA Official Sites.
  • Contribute to Service Level Agreement (SLA) development and alignment with Functional Area (FA) leads, ensuring requirements are clearly defined, operationally feasible, and venue-ready.
  • Support Service Level Requirement (SLR) alignment with stadium facility management teams, ensuring consistency with existing venue operations, infrastructure, and constraints.
  • Participate in readiness assessments, site walk-throughs, and test events to validate operational plans, staffing levels, infrastructure, and service flows.
  • Operational Coordination & Delivery
  • Coordinate day-to-day cleaning and waste management operations in line with approved operational plans, service levels, and schedules.
  • Support match-day, non-match-day, and peak-load operations to ensure service continuity and operational effectiveness.
  • Monitor contractor performance on site and report deviations, risks, and non-compliance to the Senior Cleaning and Waste Management Manager.
  • Sustainable Waste Operations & Infrastructure
  • Support waste minimisation and waste diversion efforts through the correct implementation of waste streams and operational controls.
  • Assist in the deployment and operation of temporary waste management infrastructure, including interim collection points and resource recovery areas.
  • Monitor correct segregation and handling of waste streams and provide practical on-site guidance to teams and contractors.
  • Monitoring, Reporting & Issue Resolution
  • Conduct regular site inspections to assess operational readiness, cleanliness standards, and waste management performance.
  • Support data collection, basic reporting, and performance tracking against defined waste diversion targets.
  • Identify operational issues early and support escalation and resolution processes in coordination with the Senior Manager.
  • Contribute to post-event reviews, lessons learned, and continuous operational improvements.
  • Team & Contractor Coordination
  • Support on-site supervision and coordination of cleaning and waste management crews.
  • Assist with operational briefings, inductions, and coordination meetings.
  • Promote compliance with HSE requirements and safe working practices across all operations.

Your Profile

  • Minimum 3–5 years of experience in cleaning, waste management, facility operations, practical sustainability or event operations.
  • Experience of working at large-scale sporting events, major events, or complex multi-venue operations is strongly preferred.
  • Practical understanding of cleaning operations, sustainable upstream and downstream management of discarded materials, and contractor-based service delivery.
  • Experience coordinating service providers and working in live operational environments.
  • Bachelor’s degree in Facility Management, Environmental Management, Sustainability, Engineering, or a related field is preferred.
  • Strong operational coordination and organisational skills.
  • Ability to work effectively in fast-paced, high-pressure event environments.
  • Clear communication skills and ability to work across multiple stakeholders.
  • Problem-solving mindset with a hands-on, solution-oriented approach.
  • Good reporting and documentation skills.
  • Working knowledge of HSE principles related to cleaning and waste operations.
  • Willingness to travel extensively between FIFA Official Sites
  • Flexibility to work irregular hours, including match days and peak operational periods
  • Right to work in Brazil.
  • Fluent in English (spoken and written)
  • Fluent in Portuguese (spoken and written)
  • Ability to re-locate to Rio de Janeiro.

title: Analista de Marketing Direto
description:
Overview

1. COMO É SER UMA PESSOA ANALISTA DE MARKETING DIRETO EM MSF-BRASIL?

Você irá desenvolver, implementar e analisar ações de marketing direto, com ênfase em canais offline como malas diretas e cartas de relacionamento, visando fortalecer o vínculo com a base de pessoas doadoras, ampliar a captação de recursos e potencializar o engajamento e a retenção.

Além disso, irá atuar com inovação nas abordagens, otimizando as ações de relacionamento e maximização dos resultados, acompanhando o desempenho das campanhas, identificando oportunidades de melhorias e novos formatos. Além disso, atuar para que todas as ações e materiais de marketing direto reflitam práticas de diversidade, equidade e inclusão, utilizando linguagem acolhedora, acessível e representativa, considerando diferentes perfis da base de pessoas doadoras.

Desafios

2. QUAIS SERÃO SEUS DESAFIOS?

  • Contribuir para a sustentabilidade e o crescimento da rentabilidade do canal offline, buscando a máxima de resultados e eficiência em custos de produção e logística postal;
  • Evoluir o modelo de marketing direto offline, incorporando análises mais profundas de dados e maior integração com estratégias de canais digitais;
  • Contribuir para uma cultura de análise e otimização contínua, orientando as ações baseadas em dados e subsidiando decisões.

Dia a dia

3. COMO É O DIA DIA DA POSIÇÃO?

Atividades de Marketing e Relacionamento

  • Planejar, implementar e otimizar campanhas de marketing direto offline (malas, cartas e materiais impressos), contribuindo com a Coordenação desde a construção até a mensuração dos resultados;
  • Executar segmentações e propor novos critérios e testes A/B, documentando aprendizados hipóteses resultados e fluxos;
  • Supervisionar o fluxo de produção com pessoas fornecedoras internas e externas de mala direta e materiais institucionais, assegurando prazos, qualidade e respeitando orçamento e custos finais de acordo com a verba disponível;
  • Acompanhar e realizar análise de resultados de campanhas, elaborando relatórios e propondo melhorias com base em métricas, como taxa de resposta, custo por aquisição, valor médio de doação e taxa de retenção;
  • Contribuir para que as peças, textos e segmentações adotem linguagem inclusiva, evitando vieses ou estereótipos e assegurando que diferentes perfis de pessoas doadoras se sintam respeitados e representados;
  • Acompanhar tendências e benchmarks de mercado em marketing direto e relacionamento com pessoas doadoras, aplicando boas práticas e sugerindo melhorias;
  • Considerar acessibilidade e inclusão nas propostas e revisões de materiais impressos e digitais, identificando ajustes que tornem a comunicação mais clara e inclusiva;
  • Contribuir ativamente para o planejamento anual de marketing direto, identificando oportunidades de inovação, otimização de processos e aumento de eficiência;
  • Contribuir para a integração das ações de marketing direto com campanhas digitais, fortalecendo a jornada multicanal da pessoa doadora;
  • Adotar metodologias ágeis, trabalhando em ciclos curtos de entrega, aprendizado contínuo e adaptação às mudanças;
  • Trabalhar em colaboração com as demais células do Hub, assegurando coesão das estratégias de relacionamento e desenvolvimento, de acordo com os objetivos estratégicos de cada área;

Compromissos Institucionais – MSF-Brasil

  • Atuar de forma alinhada aos valores e princípios da organização, contribuindo para um ambiente de trabalho ético, equitativo e inclusivo, pautado pela escuta ativa, pelo respeito e pela colaboração;
  • Conhecer e aplicar as diretrizes éticas de MSF-Brasil e os Compromissos Comportamentais da organização no exercício de suas atividades, promovendo um ambiente de trabalho respeitoso, transparente e coerente com os princípios institucionais;
  • Colaborar com outras áreas e equipes de forma proativa, contribuindo para o fortalecimento do trabalho transversal e para a melhoria contínua de processos;
  • Contribuir, dentro de suas atribuições, para a implementação dos objetivos definidos nos planejamentos estratégico e operacional, com responsabilidade sobre suas entregas e atenção à qualidade do trabalho;
  • Adotar práticas que valorizem a diversidade, a equidade e a inclusão, respeitando diferentes perspectivas, combatendo qualquer forma de discriminação e contribuindo para um ambiente seguro e acolhedor para todas as pessoas.

Requisitos

4. O QUE VOCÊ PRECISA TER?

  • Graduação completa em Marketing e áreas afins
  • Experiência em relacionamento com clientes/pessoas doadoras ou comunicação (campanhas offline)
  • Proficiência intermediária em Inglês
  • Conhecimentos de Pacote office e CRM
  • Conhecimento de ferramentas de BI, relatórios de performance e análise de resultados
  • Conhecimentos de diversidade, equidade e inclusão em campanhas

Competências

5. QUAIS SÃO AS COMPETÊNCIAS NECESSÁRIAS?

Você precisará demonstrar pensamento analítico para interpretar dados e apoiar a tomada de decisões nas ações de marketing direto. Será essencial manter planejamento e organização para gerenciar atividades, prazos e entregas com qualidade. A iniciativa e a inovação serão importantes para propor melhorias e ajustes nos processos, assim como a capacidade de negociação para atuar de forma colaborativa com áreas internas e fornecedores, buscando soluções alinhadas aos objetivos de MSF.

PRINCÍPIOS E CULTURA DE SALVAGUARDA:

MSF está em busca de pessoas que compartilhem do compromisso com uma cultura de salvaguarda, que visa garantir um ambiente seguro e acolhedor para todas as pessoas. Buscamos promover e garantir a Diversidade, Equidade e Inclusão (DEI) em todas as nossas ações e práticas. Assim, fortalecemos nossa missão e asseguramos que todas as pessoas tenham a oportunidade de contribuir e crescer na organização. Candidaturas que demonstrem alinhamento com esses valores serão altamente valorizadas.

Alinhada com os valores que orientam as ações da nossa organização em todo o mundo, consideraremos apenas a candidatura de pessoas que cumpram os requisitos estabelecidos e se identifiquem como Pessoa com Deficiência (PcD).

Venha fazer parte da equipe de Médicos Sem Fronteiras Brasil!

PRAZO PARA INSCRIÇÃO: 18/02/2025

RETORNO:

Ficamos muito felizes com o seu interesse em trabalhar em MSF! Gostaríamos de reforçar que, ao final do processo, todas as pessoas candidatas receberão um retorno sobre sua participação.

title: Sales Support Specialist
description:
We are looking for a proactive Sales Support Specialist to join our team in Rio de Janeiro.

Welltec is a fast-growing, global technology company that develops and provides efficient, hi-tech solutions for the energy industry. We are active in 25 countries with more than 950 employees from over 60 different nations. This contributes to our unique atmosphere with a global dimension yet a strong foothold at the various bases.

Our technologies and services are for the global market but our solutions are local and tailored to each client. To achieve this, we depend on highly trained and motivated employees.

Our policy is to hire locally and work globally. We therefore recruit where we operate and train employees at the Welltec Academy supplemented with external training from third parties as needed.

The global dimension offers a range of opportunities for those who are motivated by a challenging and multicultural environment where employees come from very different backgrounds but with a common goal to collaborate and succeed.

The position

You will be the support person in Sales Brazil. You will be responsible for the daily support of commercial staff with all administrative tasks.

Key responsibilities

  • Assist the entire team in meeting applicable sales requirements.
  • Be the LAM focal point for CRM, Xaitporter, and good news.
  • Monitor completion (WCS) and intervention (WIS) revenue.
  • Invoice products and services.
  • Receive the PO, monitor manufacturing, and ship equipment to customers.
  • Conduct the local content certification process.
  • Control contracts, their consumption, and related information.
  • Knowledge management.
  • Register and maintain Welltec's account on client/institution platforms.
  • Assist in sales events.
  • Create reports.
  • Implement process and system improvements.

The candidate

We are looking for a colleague who wants to be part of a small, informal team, who is always ready to help each other. It is also important that you like working in an environment where things are constantly changing. In addition, you must have:

  • Minimum 3 years' experience from a similar position.
  • Professional in English.

And finally, you must be:

  • Service minded.
  • Curious and structured.
  • Proactive and good at following up.

What we offer

Working with Welltec® means challenges and personal development in a demanding work environment. It is exciting, rewarding and a varied place to work. Welltec® is an equal opportunities employer. We offer good career opportunities for the right candidate.

Also, Welltec® offers a competitive compensation package, health and dental insurance, Wellhub, Prived Pension and life insurance.

The process

If you are interested and feel you match the qualifications for this position submit your resume and application.

Interviews will be held on an ongoing basis, so we encourage you to apply as soon as possible. When you apply, please specify which of our locations that you apply for. You can apply for multiple locations.

AgileEngine is an Inc. 5000 company that creates award-winning software for Fortune 500 brands and trailblazing startups across 17+ industries. We rank among the leaders in areas like application development and AI/ML, and our people-first culture has earned us multiple Best Place to Work awards.

WHY JOIN US

If you're looking for a place to grow, make an impact, and work with people who care, we'd love to meet you!

ABOUT THE ROLE

As a Middle HubSpot Administrator , you’ll play a key role in keeping our CRM and Marketing Hub running efficiently by maintaining clean data, optimizing workflows, and supporting daily operations across marketing, sales, and operations teams. You’ll help streamline processes, improve campaign execution, and ensure our HubSpot ecosystem stays organized, accurate, and scalable. This new role offers the chance to influence how we manage lifecycle engagement, enhance internal collaboration, and continuously refine a platform that drives meaningful business outcomes.

WHAT YOU WILL DO

  • Maintain and optimize HubSpot CRM structure, workflows, properties, and lists.
  • Ensure clean, accurate data through regular audits, deduplication, and database organization.
  • Create and update forms, landing pages, CTAs, and basic email campaigns (newsletters, segmented emails).
  • Support outreach operations through sequences, templates, and management of connected tools.
  • Assist with planning, tracking, and reporting for marketing campaigns, including basic dashboards.

MUST HAVES

  • 1+ years of hands-on experience working closely with HubSpot CRM.
  • Strong understanding of CRM organization, workflows, properties, and data structure.
  • Excellent organizational skills and attention to detail.
  • Ability to manage multiple requests and communicate clearly across teams.
  • Proactive, process-oriented, and comfortable improving existing systems.

NICE TO HAVES

  • Experience executing or supporting marketing campaigns end-to-end.
  • Basic HTML/CSS for small template or email adjustments.
  • Familiarity with marketing lifecycle or lead management.
  • Experience with design tools (Canva, Figma, etc) for newsletters/forms.

PERKS AND BENEFITS

  • Professional growth: Accelerate your professional journey with mentorship, TechTalks, and personalized growth roadmaps.
  • Competitive compensation: We match your ever-growing skills, talent, and contributions with competitive USD-based compensation and budgets for education, fitness, and team activities.
  • A selection of exciting projects: Join projects with modern solutions development and top-tier clients that include Fortune 500 enterprises and leading product brands.
  • Flextime: Tailor your schedule for an optimal work-life balance, with options for working from home and going to the office—whatever makes you happiest and most productive.

ALLOS é uma marca com uma forte herança. São cerca de 50 anos de experiência, transformando o mercado no Brasil. Somos referência em excelência e inovação, com a qualidade e confiança que faz parte da nossa história.

A nova marca surgiu pronta para o futuro, a partir da fusão entre a Aliansce Sonae e a brMalls, em 2023. Mas, essa trajetória começou bem antes.

Tudo começou com a Aliansce, que inaugurou o primeiro shopping da região Nordeste e o segundo do Brasil em 1975. Em 2019, a fusão entre a Aliansce e a Sonae Sierra deu origem à Aliansce Sonae, tornando-se líder na administração de shoppings no Brasil, com 32 empreendimentos. Em 2006, surge a brMalls resultando em um portfólio de 30 ativos presentes nas cinco regiões do país.

E assim, em 2023, a ALLOS surge com o encontro de duas potências nacionais do segmento, unindo forças para se tornar a mais inovadora plataforma de entretenimento, lifestyle, serviços e compras.

Nossa história continua e estamos prontos para criar momentos que transformam e impactam a vida das pessoas, gerando conexões e oportunidades.

title: Pessoa Executiva de Vendas Hunter Sênior| Supply Chain
description:
Pessoa Executiva de Vendas Hunter Sênior| Supply Chain

Descrição da vaga

Buscamos um profissional para garantir o cumprimento das metas através da comercialização de produtos e serviços TOTVS com um processo que permita buscar um suspect, compreender suas necessidades, apresentar produtos e serviços, gerar oportunidades, propor, adequar, vender e entregar soluções, sempre mantendo um contínuo relacionamento técnico e empresarial.

Responsabilidades e atribuições

  • Gerir sua carteira de clientes e construir um relacionamento visando rentabilizar, blindar e elevar o nível de satisfação da base TOTVS em relação às responsabilidades do AR nos indicadores de NPS (Farmer);
  • Prospectar novos negócios na base instalada e/ou em novos clientes, visando ampliar Market Share TOTVS (Hunter);
  • Planejar e executar o plano tático alinhado ao planejamento estratégico da DRG e resultados de vendas no segmento/região de atuação;
  • Ser especialista e liderar o assunto no seu negócio, sendo capaz de estabelecer discursos e formas de atuação altamente adequadas ao perfil de cada cliente/prospect/segmento;
  • Assegurar o cumprimento das metas individuais e metas de venda do time do Comercial em que estiver atuando, de acordo com a estratégia da TOTVS;
  • Visitar e assistir a base instalada e os novos clientes, garantindo sempre a excelência do atendimento TOTVS e buscando recorrentemente novos negócios;
  • Atender e se relacionar com o mercado e com a base instalada, através de visitas, reuniões, contatos telefônicos e e-mails;
  • Planejar, executar e liderar o processo de vendas de um produto ou serviço TOTVS ao mercado;
  • Levantar e analisar as informações do negócio, compilar e montar um plano de trabalho apoiado pela metodologia de vendas TOTVS;
  • Registrar no CRM e comunicar a área de Estratégia Comercial/Operações e Segmentos, informações relevantes sobre mercado/carteira;
  • Atuar como facilitador para a solução das demandas dos clientes e prospects;
  • Realizar a interface com as áreas internas da TOTVS;
  • Entregar e acompanhar a entrega dos produtos e/ou serviços TOTVS, garantindo que os acordos sejam cumpridos e os objetivos atendidos;
  • Realizar pós-venda com o objetivo de garantir o atendimento e gerar novas oportunidades (Cross Sell e Up Sell);
  • Mentorar profissionais do AR com o objetivo de compartilhar conhecimento e colaborar para o desenvolvimento da equipe;
  • Ser referência técnica e comercial no seu segmento de atuação;
  • Exercer liderança informal na equipe, apoiando diretamente a gestão formal da empresa;
  • Atuar como multiplicador de conhecimento e auxiliar no desenvolvimento de executivos com alto nível de performance, atuando como buddy para novos TOTVERs;
  • Atuar de forma consultiva em abordagens comerciais por meio de soluções segmentadas conforme área de atuação, potencializando a percepção de valor pelo cliente/prospect sobre os produtos e serviços TOTVS.

Requisitos e qualificações

  • Pós Graduação, Especialização ou MBA completo;
  • Vivência com vendas B2B de software de tecnologia e ERP;
  • Perfil Hunter, de prospecção de novos negócios;
  • Familiaridade com segmento de Supply Chain.
  • Universidade em Rede TOTVS, uma universidade Corporativa com conteúdos e certificações gratuitos para cada TOTVER;
  • Programa +Saudáveis, que cuida de cada TOTVER com assessoria e ações voltadas para o bem estar em corpo, mente e finanças pessoais;
  • Programa +Vantagens, a maior rede de descontos da América Latina, exclusivos para TOTVERS;
  • Programa + Cuidado, programa de apoio pessoal para TOTVERS e familiares, com orientações em diversas especialidades como: psicologia, serviço social, pet consultoria...

Do you have a strong background in quality assurance, a structured approach to testing, and want to join one of the largest technology companies in the Nordics? Then this is the role for you.

In this role, you will work in close collaboration with product, engineering, and design teams, ensuring high quality, reliability, and scalability of backend services in a modern cloud-based environment.

When joining Tieto Tech Consulting as a Quality Assurance Engineer, you will

  • Partner with product, engineering, and design teams to refine user stories, ensuring acceptance criteria are clear, complete, and testable.
  • Conduct daily evaluations of the QA swimlane in JIRA for new feature work and collaborate with engineers to execute test cycles.
  • Design, develop, and document comprehensive test plans and test cases for new and existing backend services.
  • Develop and maintain Postman API tests and automated integration test suites targeting backend services and data flows across AWS components (SQS, SNS, DynamoDB, EventBridge).
  • Implement and manage API contract testing to validate integrations and ensure data consistency across internal and external services.
  • Design, execute, and maintain performance, load, and stress tests for critical backend infrastructure to ensure scalability and reliability.
  • Collaborate with engineering teams to define and test security, access control, and compliance requirements (e.g. HIPAA) for backend services handling sensitive data.
  • Integrate automated test suites into CI/CD pipelines (GitHub Actions) to establish continuous quality gates and support safe, frequent deployments.
  • Manage initial release completion, acting as the first quality gate by approving tickets when testing passes or returning them for rework when defects are identified.
  • Collaborate with QA Engineers across squads to ensure a consistent and high-quality experience for both patient- and provider-facing features.

Who we are looking for

  • Experienced QA professional with 5+ years of experience in startup or fast-paced environments, combining strong manual testing skills with automated testing capabilities.
  • At least 3 years of hands-on experience testing AWS-based backend architectures using Kubernetes.
  • Strong understanding of testing patterns for distributed systems and AWS services such as SQS, SNS, DynamoDB, and EventBridge .
  • Proficiency in a modern programming language such as Python, Java, or TypeScript for writing and maintaining automated test suites.
  • Proven experience designing and implementing automated integration, end-to-end, and component tests .
  • Experience with performance, load, and stress testing applied to backend infrastructure.
  • Hands-on experience with API contract testing frameworks .
  • Working knowledge of CI/CD principles and experience integrating automated tests into deployment pipelines.
  • Familiarity with agile development practices and bug tracking tools (e.g. JIRA, BrowserStack ).
  • Strong analytical mindset with a continuous improvement approach.
  • Detail-oriented in test execution and thorough in documentation.
  • Strong communication skills and ability to collaborate effectively within cross-functional teams.

Experience in the healthcare domain is considered an advantage.

As a person, you are a team player who takes responsibility for quality, works in a structured and disciplined manner, and communicates clearly. You value accuracy, reliability, and continuous improvement in everything you do.

We offer

We offer professional growth, meaningful projects, an open culture, and a strong work-life balance. You will have the opportunity to work in a growing and future-oriented sector, contributing to high-impact digital solutions. We provide a hybrid work model as part of our culture and way of working, and we believe in curiosity and continuous learning as technology evolves.

We perform background checks on all final candidates. Tieto declines calls from recruitment companies.

At Tieto, we believe in the power of diversity, equity, and inclusion. We encourage applicants of all backgrounds, genders (m/f/d), and walks of life to join our team, as we believe that this fosters an inspiring workplace and fuels innovation. Your production process is smooth, predictable, and organized. Clients trust your communication and follow your timelines. title: Senior Email Marketing Manager
description:
About Darkroom

Darkroom is the leading next-generation growth marketing firm engineering the brands of tomorrow. Founded in 2017, we set out to redefine what a modern agency could be, by replacing the inertia of legacy advertising behemoths with a model built for speed, intelligence, and measurable impact.

At our core, Darkroom is a human services company powered by Matter , a universal AI commerce layer that integrates executive-level strategy with proprietary agentic technology. This fusion enables our teams to deliver outsized returns by enhancing creative output, operational efficiency, and revenue generation across every stage of the customer journey.

Our track record speaks for itself: billions in attributable revenue driven across e-commerce marketplaces, media networks, DTC ecosystems, and social commerce platforms. Every engagement feeds into our proprietary data infrastructure, enabling a continuous feedback loop that accelerates growth, improves margins, and compounds results across our client portfolio.

What began as a boutique design studio has evolved into one of the fastest-growing private companies in America (Inc. 5000) and among the most effective performance media agencies of the 2020s (Varos) . Our founders were recognized by Forbes 30 Under 30 for advancing the intersection of technology, marketing, and advertising, cementing Darkroom’s role as a defining player in the future of media innovation.

About the role

We are hiring a Senior Manager, Retention—a seasoned CRM strategist and operator who brings equal parts creativity, technical depth, and leadership maturity to the table. This is not a maintenance role; it requires strategic ownership, hands‑on execution, and a bias for measurable impact. You’ll lead a team of lifecycle marketing experts to build sophisticated email, SMS, and loyalty programs that drive retention, increase LTV, and power sustained growth for a portfolio of fast‑scaling e‑commerce brands. This role demands sharp customer insight to turn data into strategy, comfort with complexity, and the ability to influence clients and internal stakeholders alike. You’ll report to our Director of Retention and collaborate closely with Performance, Creative, and Strategy teams to deliver cohesive, cross‑channel campaigns rooted in data and customer psychology.

This is a fully remote role supporting a team in the EST time zone and is open to candidates based in Portugal, Mexico, Brazil, and Spain.

You Should Apply if this sounds like you:

You’re passionate about e‑commerce and digital marketing. You’re immersed in the world of direct‑to‑consumer growth marketing. We're looking for an expert Senior Manager, Retention to join our team! In this role, you will join a growing team within the Retention Marketing Department to strategically develop customized CRM and retention marketing strategies that help our clients grow and scale through email and SMS, subscription, and loyalty programs.

  • 7+ years of work experience in digital marketing.
  • You immerse yourself in scaling personalized D2C/e‑commerce email and SMS programs that build deep customer relationships for clients.
  • You can creatively message the value propositions of any brand’s product catalog to create email and SMS campaigns that customers find to be engaging, informative, and persuasive.
  • You’re passionate about developing creative customer journeys and loyalty programs that drive loyalty and lifetime value.
  • You have experience working in Klaviyo (or a similar ESP’s) including list segmentation, lifecycle drip automations, and triggered events. Additionally, you have knowledge of Shopify and their tech stack options such as Privy, JustUno, Yotpo, Octane AI etc.
  • You have developed SMS and loyalty programming strategies and have experience working with SMS platforms such as Attentive, PostScript, SMSBump, or Klaviyo.
  • You're used to working in a fast paced environment and can project manage multiple tasks at once for yourself, your team and your clients.
  • You love making data driven decisions and excel at turning analytics into actionable SMS and email strategies that drive client revenue.
  • You dedicate time to learning and being on the cutting edge of trends and best practices in the world of DTC marketing.
  • You have experience developing and executing customer loyalty programs that enhance LTV.
  • You've had at least one direct report before and exceptional leadership skills working with cross‑functional teams.
  • Excellent verbal and written communication and presentation skills, plus ability to clearly articulate and express complex and sometimes technical ideas to a wide variety of people and groups at any level.

A Day in the Life:

  • Serve as the senior point of contact for select clients, working to develop best‑in‑class retention strategies. On a weekly basis, you will meet with clients to discuss current and future initiatives.
  • Develop strategic campaign calendars and prioritize projects and initiatives designed to scale your clients’ email and SMS programs.
  • Provide support and guidance to help Retention Specialists analyze data, develop winning retention strategies and create reports for clients happiness.
  • Project manage and delegate client tasks to your team, consisting of both specialists and designers. Review all client briefs and designs for approval before they are sent to the client.
  • Coordinate cross‑departmentally with the Performance Marketing and Strategy teams to develop cohesive and creative campaigns that drive client growth.
  • Assign segmentation and QA email and SMS campaigns ensuring flawless delivery to customer audiences.
  • Report on strategic KPIs for clients, creating insights and actionable recommendations to grow client retention engagement and revenue.
  • Execute on automation/flow logic set‑up, pop‑up builds, and app integrations.

Working at Darkroom

Darkroom is not a typical agency. We are looking for A players that want to build something great. There is no room in our organization for mediocrity and candidates that are not at the top of their game do not last. We move fast, think deeply, and expect every team member to bring insight and rigor to everything they touch. We hold a high bar for performance, creativity, and ownership — but we also support each other relentlessly. No egos, no red tape — just world‑class talent building something remarkable.

We believe in autonomy with accountability , truth over comfort , and outcomes over optics . If you want to build and win alongside some of the smartest people in the business, you’ll thrive here.

  • Location, location, (or no) location: Remote‑first culture with a strong community base. While many roles remain fully remote, employees hired to work from our New York or Lisbon HQs (opening early 2026) are expected to adopt a hybrid working model, including weekly in‑office appearances. Hub locations also include the Bay Area, Philly, São Paulo, and Barcelona.
  • Parental Leave: flexible parental leave benefits to support new parents during this important transition, ensuring time to bond with their families while maintaining work‑life balance.
  • Endless opportunities for growth: Our agency is founded on an interdisciplinary approach, giving Darkroomers insights into services far beyond your job description. Grow your skills and interests beyond your niche and stay at the forefront of the industry through total immersion in cross‑functional collaboration.

Equal Opportunity Statement

Darkroom is an equal opportunity workplace—we are dedicated to equal employment opportunities regardless of race, color, ancestry, religion, sex, national orientation, sexual orientation, age, citizenship, marital status, disability, gender identity, or Veteran status. We also consider qualified applicants regardless of criminal histories, consistent with legal requirements.

title: Head of Event Services FIFA Women’s World Cup 2027TM
description:
FIFA has established a Local FIFA Subsidiary in Brazil to work together with FIFA Zurich to deliver the biggest women’s sporting event in the world, the FIFA Women’s World Cup 2027™ (“FWWC2027”) that for the first time ever, is hosted in South America in Brazil. Now is your time to be part of the workforce that is creating this unique and unforgettable experience.

Please submit your CV in English, as it will be reviewed by an international team.

Job Description

The Head of Event Services shall have dual reporting to the Event Services Director in FIFA HQ Zurich and to the Executive Operations Director. Under the leadership of the FIFA HQ team, they shall ensure the successful operational planning, management and implementation of the Accommodation, Travel, Logistics, Transport and Guest Operations projects for the FIFA Women’s World Cup™ (“FWWC”).

The Head of Event Services will work together with the Event Services Team in FIFA HQ Zurich to ensure

  1. Drive FIFA’s leadership in Event Services, encompassing the above areas.
  2. Ensure suitable and efficient business models and processes for operation across multiple different events, of different scales, simultaneously, across all areas under auspice.
  3. Continuously assess and propose improvements to the requirements and regulations for the services. Integrate these enhancements into the Master Project Plans and detailed budgets, ensuring stakeholder alignment and cost-effective delivery for each event within the FIFA Women’s World Cup 2027 project.
  4. Follow the trends of the industry to be ready to anticipate changes in a responsible and timely manner.

Key responsibilities

Operational Excellence and Project Delivery

  • Plan and execute projects and services, ensuring they are delivered on time, within scope, and within budget, while maintaining high-quality standards.
  • Serve as the primary point of contact for the Executive Operations Director regarding all service-related matters, representing the Director on various occasions as needed.
  • Develop and implement efficient project plans and procedures for all tournaments and events in collaboration with other Subdivisions, ensuring seamless execution.

Collaboration and Team Integration

  • Contribute to the overall success of the FIFA Women’s World Cup 2027 as an active member of the management team, fostering strong collaboration across FIFA27.
  • Ensure the Event Services department consistently delivers high-quality services to tournament project teams, positioning itself as a key service provider.
  • Collaborate with other departments to share responsibility for the FWWC’s overall success, ensuring alignment with broader goals and objectives, and maintaining a focus on the big picture.

Stakeholder Engagement and Networking

  • Cultivate close cooperation with staff members across all divisions to ensure an exceptional user experience (UX). This includes coordinating with FIFA stakeholders, local FIFA subsidiaries, stadium/venue owners, host associations, local authorities, and third-party partners to create optimal conditions.
  • Share relevant information within the FIFA27 and with other internal and external stakeholders to ensure effective communication and collaboration

Your profile

  • Independent and Flexible: Ability to lead large teams independently in complex environments, and situations with ambiguity
  • Effective Communication and Trust Building: Skilled in fostering open communication and creating an environment of trust. Capable of understanding and addressing the needs and expectations of others, identifying and resolving conflicts, and delivering impactful presentations. Experienced negotiator in an international context
  • Client-Centric Approach: Consistently demonstrates respect and professionalism toward clients (colleagues, superiors, member associations, clubs, etc.). Clearly defines and aligns expectations, ensuring client needs are met and exceeded. Receives positive client feedback, builds strong, trusting relationships, and anticipates client needs. Maintains a flexible and innovative mindset in service delivery
  • Leadership and Team Development: Respected leader within the team, setting ambitious objectives and motivating staff to achieve them. Inspires collaboration and fosters a high-performance culture. Well-regarded by peers and top management, adapting goals to client needs and driving continuous improvement. Effectively manages pressure, supports team growth, and handles challenges with strong interpersonal and conflict-resolution skills
  • Strategic Thinking: Demonstrates the ability to assess the broader impact of organizational decisions and developments, anticipating their consequences.
  • Decisive Action and Risk Management: Recognizes situations that require swift, pragmatic decision-making. Takes initiative, explores various solutions, and is willing to take calculated risks. Acts promptly and decisively in response to unexpected challenges.
  • Planning and Resource Management: Skilled in developing detailed, chronological plans, setting priorities, and allocating resources effectively. Implements systems for tracking progress and control, and adapts plans as needed to achieve objectives. Maintains a strong focus on reporting and accountability.
  • Collaboration in a Multi-National Team: Leads and collaborates effectively in diverse, cross-cultural teams. Navigates cultural differences, fosters inclusivity, and ensures seamless communication across global teams, driving alignment and achieving shared goals.
  • A minimum sports event management experience of 5 years, ideally on an international level in the Event Services (Accommodation, Travel, Logistics, Transport and Guest Operations).
  • Extensive knowledge of event and sport facility operations
  • Strong knowledge of event planning and event project management processes
  • Strong administrative and IT skills including MS Office (Word, Excel, PowerPoint)
  • Ability to effectively monitor organisational performance and implement decisive corrective actions
  • Right to work in Brazil (desirable)
  • Fluent in English (spoken and written)
  • Ability to re-locate to Rio de Janeiro soon.

About FIFA Women’s World Cup 2027

The FIFA Women’s World Cup™ is the greatest women’s sporting event on the planet, showcasing the best players in the world on the biggest stage. In 2027, history will be made as Brazil welcomes the tournament to South America for the first time ever.

This landmark event will unite the world through an unprecedented celebration of women’s football, inspiring billions of fans across the globe. As we prepare to host teams and supporters from every corner of the world, we’re looking for passionate, talented individuals to be part of history and help deliver an unforgettable tournament.

Join us and play your role in making FIFA Women’s World Cup 2027™ a truly extraordinary experience that celebrates and elevates women’s football.

Na Bunge, nosso objetivo é conectar agricultores a consumidores para fornecer alimentos, ingredientes para nutrição animal e combustível essenciais para o mundo. Como uma fornecedora líder de soluções para o agronegócio, nossa equipe de aproximadamente 37.000 colaboradores dedicados atua em parceria com agricultores ao redor do mundo para movimentar commodities agrícolas de onde são produzidas para onde são necessárias — de maneira mais rápida, inteligente e eficiente. Somos uma empresa líder mundial em originação, armazenamento, distribuição, além de processamento e refino de oleaginosas, oferecendo um amplo portfólio de óleos, gorduras e proteínas de origem vegetal. Atuamos lado a lado com nossos clientes em ambas as pontas da cadeia de valor para fornecer produtos de qualidade e desenvolver soluções inovadoras e personalizadas que atendam às necessidades em constante evolução dos consumidores. Com mais de 200 anos de experiência e presença em mais de 50 países, temos o compromisso de fortalecer a segurança alimentar global, promover a sustentabilidade e contribuir para a prosperidade das comunidades onde operamos. A Bunge tem sede registrada em Genebra, Suíça, e sua sede corporativa está localizada em St. Louis, Missouri, EUA. Saiba mais em bunge.com.br.

Diariamente, nossos profissionais incorporam os valores que são a essência da Bunge:

  • SOMOS UM SÓ TIME – Colaborativo, respeitoso e inclusivo
  • LIDERAMOS O CAMINHO – Somos ágeis, Empoderados e inovadores
  • FAZEMOS O QUE É CERTO – Com segurança, de forma sustentável e com integridade

Reconhecemos que nosso sucesso depende da variedade de perspectivas que cada um de nossos colaboradores agrega à Bunge. Estamos empenhados em promover práticas para nutrir uma cultura de pertencimento para todos. Globalmente, apoiamos os Princípios de Empoderamento das Mulheres, de ONU Mulheres. No Brasil, somos associados ao Mover - Movimento pela Equidade Racial, e fomos eleitos pela ferramenta global Disability Index Report® como um dos melhores locais para se trabalhar em relação à inclusão de pessoas com deficiência. Atuamos continuamente em prol de nosso compromisso de deixar um legado positivo em todas as comunidades onde atuamos.

Se você se identifica com esses valores, junte-se a nós! Valorizamos e investimos em pessoas que acreditam em nosso propósito e o vivenciam com entusiasmo a cada dia – pessoas que têm #OrgulhodeSerBunge

  • Coleta de Informações: realizar (via aplicativo Involves) pesquisas de preço, presença de produtos, espaço em gôndola, implementação de MPDV, abertura de caixas, ações da concorrência, condições de exposição, entre outros, de acordo com a necessidade do momento (informações da Limppano e da concorrência).
  • Relatórios e Feedbacks: registrar evidências (fotos e informações) das execuções e enviar relatórios diários através do aplicativo Involves.
  • Relacionamento: conquistar e manter um bom relacionamento com o time de loja para facilitar as operações e execuções.
  • Sugestão de Transferências: realizar sugestão de transferência de mercadoria do Centro de Distribuição (CD) para as lojas.

  • Formação: ensino médio completo. Desejável formação técnica ou superior em andamento (Marketing, Administração, Logística, etc).
  • Experiência: vivência anterior como Promotor de Vendas no setor de limpeza será um diferencial.

title: Manager, Cleaning and Waste Management FIFA Women’s World Cup 2027TM
description:
Overview

FIFA has established a Local FIFA Subsidiary in Brazil to work together with FIFA Zurich to deliver the biggest women’s sporting event in the world, the FIFA Women’s World Cup 2027™ (”FWWC2027” ) that for the first time ever is hosted in South America in Brazil. Now is your time to be part of the workforce that is creating this unique and unforgettable experience.

Please submit your CV in English, as it will be reviewed by an international team.

Job Description

The position

The Cleaning and Waste Management Manager, reporting to both FIFA27 Head of Infrastructure & Technical Services and the FIFA Technical Services Senior Manager, will be a key member of the FIFA27 team. This role involves close coordination with key stakeholders to meet operational, environmental, and service quality standards.

The position is responsible for developing, coordinating implementation, and overseeing sustainable cleaning and waste management strategies and operations from planning through implementation to closure across all FIFA Official Sites. This includes leading upstream and downstream waste management and ensuring a seamless, high-quality tournament experience in line with FIFA’s and regional sustainability standards.

The ideal candidate will combine event operations, sustainable cleaning, and waste management expertise with strong project management skills. This role will focus on optimizing operational efficiency, ensuring stakeholder satisfaction, and minimizing environmental impact while adhering to FIFA’s stringent standards.

Key responsibilities

  • Act as the primary liaison between FIFA Functional Areas, Local Entities, contractors, and external stakeholders for sustainable cleaning and waste management services.
  • Lead and manage cleaning and waste management team, ensuring efficiency and high performance.
  • Develop and implement the Sustainable Waste management strategy and cleaning operational plan, ensuring alignment with FIFA’s requirements.
  • Develop and manage sustainable cleaning and waste management services budget, ensuring cost control and operational efficiency.
  • Lead the planning, installation, and operations of temporary waste management infrastructure across stadiums, training sites, and other FIFA Official Sites.
  • Ensure full integration of cleaning and waste management requirements, maximizing the use of existing venue infrastructure while meeting FIFA standards and event operational needs.
  • Oversee the end-to-end delivery of sustainable cleaning and waste management services, managing resources, partners, suppliers, and contractors to ensure successful execution.
  • Conduct site visits to validate operational readiness, ensuring feasibility, quality, and compliance with operational needs.
  • Oversee the planning and delivery of temporary power, lighting, and other essential technical services for Resource Recovery Centers.
  • Ensure compliance with FIFA’s facility management standards.
  • Collaborate with stadium facility management teams, suppliers, and local authorities to guarantee operational readiness by the highest sustainability standards.
  • Provide regular updates to the FIFA Technical Services Senior Manager on key milestones, issues, and recommendations.
  • Coordinate with local authorities the process to secure necessary permits and approvals.
  • Track and report on project progress, identifying risks and mitigation strategies.
  • Identify opportunities for process improvement and innovation in service planning and delivery.

Your profile

  • Bachelor’s or Master’s in Resource Management, Economics, Sustainability, Facility Management or a related field.
  • Minimum 10+ years of experience planning and executing sustainable cleaning and waste management services for major sporting events.
  • Proven track record of leading cleaning and waste management service teams in FIFA tournaments or similar global events.
  • Experience in budget management, procurement, and supplier coordination.
  • Strong understanding of stakeholders’ requirements and responsibilities to deliver efficient and sustainable operations.
  • Extensive knowledge of cleaning and waste management delivery, temporary infrastructure, and venue technical services for major sporting events.
  • Proficiency in project management tools.
  • Strong analytical and problem-solving skills with the ability to assess and implement effective solutions.
  • Excellent negotiation and contract management skills.
  • Right to work in Brazil.
  • Fluent in English (spoken and written)
  • Fluent in Portuguese (spoken and written)
  • Ability to re-locate to Rio de Janeiro.

About FIFA Women’s World Cup 2027

The FIFA Women’s World Cup™ is the greatest women’s sporting event on the planet, showcasing the best players in the world on the biggest stage. In 2027, history will be made as Brazil welcomes the tournament to South America for the first time ever.

This landmark event will unite the world through an unprecedented celebration of women’s football, inspiring billions of fans across the globe. As we prepare to host teams and supporters from every corner of the world, we’re looking for passionate, talented individuals to be part of history and help deliver an unforgettable tournament.

Join us and play your role in making FIFA Women’s World Cup 2027™ a truly extraordinary experience that celebrates and elevates women’s football.

Description

FIFA has established a Local FIFA Subsidiary in Brazil to work together with FIFA Zurich to deliver the biggest women’s sporting event in the world, the FIFA Women’s World Cup 2027™ (“FWWC2027”). THE POSITION

The Accreditation Client Group Manager plays a key role in the operational delivery of client group accreditation services in support of tournament operations across all venues and official facilities. Reporting to the Accreditation Client Group Senior Manager, the Accreditation Client Group Manager is responsible for the day‑to‑day coordination, and delivery of accreditation services for assigned client groups for the FIFA Women’s World Cup 2027™.

Working within the established tournament accreditation framework, and in close collaboration with FIFA Zurich Accreditation, FIFA27 Accreditation teams and functional areas, the role ensures that client group accreditation requirements are delivered in line with defined FIFA accreditation policies, access control protocols, and agreed service standards.

The role provides operational leadership to Client Group Coordinators and serves as the primary operational escalation point for assigned client groups.

KEY RESPONSIBILITIES

  • Client Group Management:
  • Act as the primary accreditation point of contact for assigned client groups (e.g. safety & security, workforce, volunteers, suppliers, commercial partners).
  • Understand and manage client group accreditation requirements, volumes, timelines, and access needs in line with the overall accreditation framework and agreed milestones.
  • Coordinate the delivery of client group accreditation activities across all planning and operational phases.
  • Monitor readiness and proactively identify delivery risks, escalating issues as required.
  • Accreditation Process Delivery:
  • Manage the end‑to‑end accreditation process for assigned client groups, including data collection, validation, access rights assignment, badge production, and distribution.
  • Ensure accurate application of access rights in accordance with approved zoning concepts, access matrices, and security requirements.
  • Coordinate accreditation activities and dependencies with Accreditation Operations, Systems, Security, and Venue teams.
  • Track application progress, volumes, and bottlenecks and implement corrective actions where required.
  • Team Leadership & Support:
  • Lead, coordinate, and support Client Group Coordinators in the delivery of day‑to‑day accreditation activities.
  • Provide guidance on complex cases and ensure consistent application of processes across client groups.
  • Support onboarding, training, and knowledge sharing within the client group team.
  • Promote clear task ownership, prioritisation, and accountability.
  • Stakeholder Engagement & Communication:
  • Work closely with FIFA and FIFA27 functional areas to support agreed accreditation requirements and timelines.
  • Communicate accreditation procedures, deadlines, and data requirements clearly and consistently to client groups.
  • Support the preparation and delivery of training sessions, briefings, and guidance materials.
  • Act as the primary operational escalation point for client group accreditation issues, escalating complex or cross‑functional matters to the Client Group Senior Manager.
  • Event‑Time Operations:
  • Support the operation of Accreditation Centres and badge distribution points before and during the tournament.
  • Coordinate with Venue Operations, Security, and Accreditation Operations teams to resolve access‑related issues quickly and effectively.
  • Provide operational decision‑making support within defined authority during peak arrival and match‑day phases.
  • Support on‑site supervision of accreditation staff and workflows as required.
  • Reporting, Compliance & Continuous Improvement:
  • Ensure all client group accreditation activities comply with FIFA accreditation regulations, data protection requirements, and security protocols.
  • Maintain accurate client group accreditation records, statistics, and issue logs.
  • Provide regular operational updates and reports to the Client Group Senior Manager.
  • Contribute to post‑event reporting, lessons learned, and knowledge transfer activities.

YOUR PROFILE

  • University degree or equivalent higher education in Event Management, Sports Administration, Operations, or a related field.
  • Minimum 5 years of experience in accreditation, access management, client services, or operations within major international events.
  • Strong working knowledge of accreditation systems, access control concepts, and venue zoning models.
  • Experience working in large‑scale, multi‑stakeholder, and multicultural event environments.
  • Strong organisational and coordination skills with a high level of attention to detail.
  • Proven ability to manage multiple priorities and deadlines in high‑pressure environments.
  • Clear and confident communicator with strong stakeholder management skills.
  • Ability to identify issues early and elevate appropriately.
  • Team‑oriented mindset with a strong focus on delivery and compliance.
  • Flexibility to work extended hours during peak tournament phases.
  • Right to work in Brazil.
  • Fluent in English (spoken and written).
  • Fluent in Portuguese (spoken and written).
  • Ability to re‑locate to Rio de Janeiro.

A Divisão de Grande Público porta a marca número 1 de beleza no mundo com L\'Oréal Paris, a marca número 1 de maquiagem com Maybelline New York e a marca natural número 1 com Garnier. A L’Oréal Grande Público é a maior divisão do grupo L\'Oréal, com mais de 30mil colaboradores ao redor do mundo.

A área Comercial da L\'Oréal é uma verdadeira força motriz por trás do sucesso das nossas marcas e clientes! A nossa equipe comercial é composta por profissionais estratégicos, analíticos, criativos e orientados para resultados, que trabalham em parceria com nossos clientes para impulsionar o crescimento dos negócios. Além disso, você terá a chance de trabalhar com os produtos mais inovadores e desejados do mercado de beleza. Junte-se a nós e faça parte dessa jornada incrível, onde você terá a oportunidade de deixar a sua marca no mundo da beleza!

Buscamos um(a) profissional com perfil empreendedor, forte visão comercial e sólida base analítica para liderar a frente de New Ventures.

Sua missão será identificar, desenhar e implementar novos modelos de negócio, parcerias estratégicas e canais de venda que elevem a experiência do consumidor de luxo e gerem novas fontes de receita. Você será o(a) arquiteto(a) de projetos que conectam o desejo do consumidor com a viabilidade financeira e a excelência operacional, atuando como um catalisador de crescimento para marcas icônicas como Lancôme, Giorgio Armani e Yves Saint Laurent.

Suas Principais Responsabilidades

  • Desenvolvimento e Prospecção de Novos Negócios: Identificar e avaliar oportunidades de expansão de mercado, novos canais de distribuição e serviços inovadores. Liderar a estruturação de business cases para novas iniciativas, desde a concepção da ideia até o plano de execução (Go-to-Market).

title: Training Site Infrastructure Coordinator FIFA Women’s World Cup 2027TM
description:
Overview

FIFA has established a Local FIFA Subsidiary in Brazil to work together with FIFA Zurich to deliver the biggest women’s sporting event in the world, the FIFA Women’s World Cup 2027™ ("FWWC2027"), which for the first time is hosted in South America in Brazil. Now is your time to be part of the workforce that is creating this unique and unforgettable experience.

Please submit your CV in English, as it will be reviewed by an international team.

Job Description

The position

The Training Site Infrastructure Coordinator reports to the Training Site Infrastructure Manager and the FIFA Training Site Manager, serving as a key member of the FIFA27 Operations team in close collaboration with the Team Services, Team Facilities team and other stakeholders.

The FIFA Women’s World Cup 2027™ requires advanced infrastructure and technical services to deliver a seamless tournament experience. The Training Site Infrastructure Coordinator will work alongside the Training Site Infrastructure Manager on the successful delivery and readiness of all FWWC2023 training site infrastructure and overlay requirements throughout the country. The manager will also project manage all Host Country and Local Entity deliverables.

This role will also work with external stakeholders, such as Training Site Authorities, to be part of the Training Site infrastructure team in planning, delivering, and preparing all FWWC2027 training sites in Brazil. The successful candidate will work with the Training Site Authorities and local entity colleagues to ensure the delivery and readiness of the renovations, beautification, upgrade and completion of existing works at training sites. In addition, they will oversee infrastructure and overlay delivery, installation, and dismantling, as well as supply and storage of field of play and training equipment at training sites.

As a member of the Technical Services & Overlay team, you will also work closely with other workstreams, such as Pitch Management, Venue Design, and Dressing and Signage, to ensure the FWWC2027 is delivered to the highest possible standard and, where possible, leaves a lasting legacy.

The successful candidate will ensure all deliverables align with FIFA’s exacting standards while optimizing operational efficiency and stakeholder satisfaction.

Key responsibilities

  • Assist the Training Site Infrastructure Manage in the design and delivery of infrastructure required at training sites for the FWWC2027.
  • Ensure specifications, space and area allocations are developed in compliance with the FIFA training site requirements and fit for purpose.
  • Monitoring the training site renovations, beautifications and upgrade program and overlay deliverables and timelines to ensure all training sites are ready for the participating Teams when they arrive.
  • Assist in the procurement, delivery and installation/storage of field of play and training equipment for all training sites.
  • Participating in regular review meetings to discuss the delivery and readiness of training sites with all external and internal stakeholders.
  • Assist in the handover and hand back of all training sites for the tournament period.
  • Working with Facility Management Services and Cleaning & Waste providers to ensure the training sites are maintained at the appropriate standards during the Teams’ time in the host country.
  • Ensure all equipment and overlay requested are provided and set up by the requirements and location.

Your profile

Qualifications

  • Minimum of 1 year experience in a coordination role in overlay, infrastructure, or technical services in events.
  • Bachelor’s degree in Engineering, Architecture, Project Management, or a related field.
  • Strong and dynamic interpersonal, leadership and communication skills with an ability to maintain focus in a high-pressure and fast-paced environment.
  • Experience in supplier coordination.
  • Relationships with local suppliers and contractors and well-established networks within the industry would be advantageous.
  • Reliable and committed to meeting quality standards and deadlines, good planning and anticipation, focus on efficient implementation, and follow up after completion.
  • Knowledge of overlay delivery, temporary infrastructure, and technical services for major sporting events.
  • Proficiency in AutoCAD, BIM 360, MS Project, and other project management tools.
  • Strong analytical and problem-solving skills with the ability to assess and implement effective solutions.
  • Excellent negotiation and contract management skills.
  • Driver’s license is a plus.
  • Right to work in Brazil.
  • Fluent in English (spoken and written)
  • Fluent in Portuguese (spoken and written)
  • Ability to re-locate to Rio de Janeiro.

About FIFA Women’s World Cup 2027

The FIFA Women’s World Cup™ is the greatest women’s sporting event on the planet, showcasing the best players in the world on the biggest stage. In 2027, history will be made as Brazil welcomes the tournament to South America for the first time ever.

This landmark event will unite the world through an unprecedented celebration of women’s football, inspiring billions of fans across the globe. As we prepare to host teams and supporters from every corner of the world, we’re looking for passionate, talented individuals to be part of history and help deliver an unforgettable tournament.

Join us and play your role in making FIFA Women’s World Cup 2027™ a truly extraordinary experience that celebrates and elevates women’s football.

  • Ability to work without close supervision

  • Flexibility in work schedule, including evenings, overnight and weekends.
  • Works well in a team environment; communicates effectively
  • Functions well in a fast-paced environment with tight timeframes and multiple demands
  • Ability to work harmoniously with the staff, officials and the general public.

Associate degree in Communications or Radio Broadcasting or 2 years of broadcast radio experience. Recent Nielsen PPM market experience.

$18 per hour

title: Quality Assurance Engineer – Tieto Tech Consulting (m/f/d)
description:
Overview

Do you have a strong background in quality assurance, a structured approach to testing, and want to join one of the largest technology companies in the Nordics? Then this is the role for you.

We are looking for a Quality Assurance Engineer who wants to be part of Tieto Tech Consulting . Tieto Tech Consulting works as a true partner, solving clients’ toughest technology challenges and delivering reliable outcomes that drive measurable results. By combining engineering excellence with disciplined quality practices, we support customers developing and operating critical digital platforms.

In this role, you will work in close collaboration with product, engineering, and design teams, ensuring high quality, reliability, and scalability of backend services in a modern cloud-based environment.

Responsibilities

  • Partner with product, engineering, and design teams to refine user stories, ensuring acceptance criteria are clear, complete, and testable.
  • Conduct daily evaluations of the QA swimlane in JIRA for new feature work and collaborate with engineers to execute test cycles.
  • Design, develop, and document comprehensive test plans and test cases for new and existing backend services.
  • Develop and maintain Postman API tests and automated integration test suites targeting backend services and data flows across AWS components (SQS, SNS, DynamoDB, EventBridge).
  • Implement and manage API contract testing to validate integrations and ensure data consistency across internal and external services.
  • Design, execute, and maintain performance, load, and stress tests for critical backend infrastructure to ensure scalability and reliability.
  • Collaborate with engineering teams to define and test security, access control, and compliance requirements (e.g. HIPAA) for backend services handling sensitive data.
  • Integrate automated test suites into CI/CD pipelines (GitHub Actions) to establish continuous quality gates and support safe, frequent deployments.
  • Manage initial release completion, acting as the first quality gate by approving tickets when testing passes or returning them for rework when defects are identified.
  • Collaborate with QA Engineers across squads to ensure a consistent and high-quality experience for both patient- and provider-facing features.

Who We Are Looking For

  • Experienced QA professional with 5+ years of experience in startup or fast-paced environments, combining strong manual testing skills with automated testing capabilities.
  • At least 3 years of hands-on experience testing AWS-based backend architectures using Kubernetes.
  • Strong understanding of testing patterns for distributed systems and AWS services such as SQS, SNS, DynamoDB, and EventBridge.
  • Proficiency in a modern programming language such as Python, Java, or TypeScript for writing and maintaining automated test suites.
  • Proven experience designing and implementing automated integration, end-to-end, and component tests.
  • Experience with performance, load, and stress testing applied to backend infrastructure.
  • Hands-on experience with API contract testing frameworks.
  • Working knowledge of CI/CD principles and experience integrating automated tests into deployment pipelines.
  • Familiarity with agile development practices and bug tracking tools (e.g. JIRA, BrowserStack).
  • Strong analytical mindset with a continuous improvement approach.
  • Detail-oriented in test execution and thorough in documentation.
  • Strong communication skills and ability to collaborate effectively within cross-functional teams.

Experience in the healthcare domain is considered an advantage.

As a person, you are a team player who takes responsibility for quality, works in a structured and disciplined manner, and communicates clearly. You value accuracy, reliability, and continuous improvement in everything you do.

We offer

We offer professional growth, meaningful projects, an open culture, and a strong work-life balance. You will have the opportunity to work in a growing and future-oriented sector, contributing to high-impact digital solutions. We provide a hybrid work model as part of our culture and way of working, and we believe in curiosity and continuous learning as technology evolves.

Location: Asunción, Paraguay (Hybrid)

We perform background checks on all final candidates.

Tieto declines calls from recruitment companies.

Additional Information

At Tieto, we believe in the power of diversity, equity, and inclusion. We encourage applicants of all backgrounds, genders (m/f/d), and walks of life to join our team, as we believe that this fosters an inspiring workplace and fuels innovation. Our commitment to openness, trust, and diversity is at the heart of our mission to create digital futures that benefit businesses, societies, and humanity.

title: Junior Linux Kernel Engineer - Ubuntu
description:
Overview

Canonical is a leading provider of open source software and operating systems to the global enterprise and technology markets. Our platform, Ubuntu, is widely used in breakthrough enterprise initiatives such as public cloud, data science, AI, engineering innovation, and IoT. Our customers include the world's leading public cloud and silicon providers, and industry leaders in many sectors. The company is a pioneer of global distributed collaboration, with 1200+ colleagues in 75+ countries and very few office-based roles. Teams meet two to four times yearly in person, in interesting locations around the world, to align on strategy and execution.

The company is founder-led, profitable, and growing. Every year we select new junior professionals into the Canonical Kernel Team, to work on the Linux kernel for Ubuntu. If you enjoyed operating systems in your coursework or current role, you are confident in your ability to write high quality C and possibly Rust, and are ready to take the plunge and see how it all works, then this would be a great place to pursue your next career stage. We are a global team working to ship the world's most widely used Linux kernel, across the very latest silicon and cloud, where you can apply and grow your software engineering skills.

Responsibilities

  • Collaborate regularly and proactively with a globally distributed team
  • Learn from senior mentors to demystify the inner workings of the Linux kernel and how it is distributed
  • Work closely with external silicon, cloud, or hardware manufacturer delivery teams on bleeding-edge platforms
  • Diagnose and resolve issues in the kernel reported by customers, the community, and discovered by your own rigorous testing
  • Take personal responsibility for the delivery of various flavors of the Ubuntu Linux kernel
  • Improve tooling and automation for delivery and test of Ubuntu Linux kernels
  • Submit, review, and apply kernel patches, working with both internal and external upstream maintainers

What we are looking for in you

  • Well-organized and motivated self-starter able to thrive in a remote work environment
  • Professional manner with colleagues, business partners, and the open-source community
  • Ability to communicate effectively in English, both written and verbal
  • Programming experience in C and/or Rust
  • Familiarity with version control practices, ideally with git
  • Understanding of operating system kernel fundamentals
  • Ability to travel twice a year for company events of up to two weeks length

Nice-to-have skills

  • Interest and experience in Rust
  • Python and Bash scripting ability
  • Prior experience with Ubuntu/Debian/Snap packaging
  • Demonstrated experience with kernel patching and debugging
  • Strong grasp of device drivers, BSP's, and other low level system engineering

What we offer colleagues

  • Distributed work environment with twice-yearly team sprints in person
  • Personal learning and development budget of USD 2,000 per year
  • Annual compensation review
  • Recognition rewards
  • Annual holiday leave
  • Maternity and paternity leave
  • Team Member Assistance Program & Wellness Platform
  • Opportunity to travel to new locations to meet colleagues
  • Priority Pass and travel upgrades for long-haul company events

About Canonical

Canonical is a pioneering tech firm at the forefront of the global move to open source. As the company that publishes Ubuntu, one of the most important open-source projects and the platform for AI, IoT, and the cloud, we are changing the world of software. We recruit on a global basis and set a very high standard for people joining the company. We expect excellence; in order to succeed, we need to be the best at what we do. Most colleagues at Canonical have worked from home since our inception in 2004. Working here is a step into the future and will challenge you to think differently, work smarter, learn new skills, and raise your game.

Canonical is an equal opportunity employer

We are proud to foster a workplace free from discrimination. Diversity of experience, perspectives, and background create a better work environment and better products. Whatever your identity, we will give your application fair consideration.

title: Finance Coordinator
description:
Overview

The Talent Acquisition department hires qualified candidates to fill positions which contribute to the overall strategic success of Howard University. Hiring staff “for fit” makes significant contributions to Howard University’s overall mission. At Howard University, we prioritize well-being and professional growth.

Benefits

  • Health & Wellness: Comprehensive medical, dental, and vision insurance, plus mental health support
  • Work-Life Balance: PTO, paid holidays, flexible work arrangements
  • Financial Wellness: Competitive salary, 403(b) with company match
  • Professional Development: Ongoing training, tuition reimbursement, and career advancement paths
  • Additional Perks: Wellness programs, commuter benefits, and a vibrant company culture

Join Howard University and thrive with us!

Job Purpose

The Finance Coordinator provides administrative and financial operations support for the Development and Alumni Relations (DAR) department and serves as a critical liaison with procurement and accounts payable to ensure that financial activities associated with financial operations, philanthropic gifts, and grants are efficiently managed, maintained, and compliant with all applicable university policies, laws, and regulations. Additional responsibilities include managing procurement, accounts payable, and financial operations efficiently.

Supervisory Authority

N/A

Nature And Scope

Reporting to the Director of Administration, the Finance Coordinator assists with the development, management, and monitoring of the department\'s budget and financial operations. The role requires an experienced administrator with a strong background in bookkeeping, able to ensure the department\'s fiscal integrity and efficiency, and compliance with university policies. This position works collaboratively across DAR and extensively with colleagues in key financial offices, including the University Budget Office, Procurement and Contracting, and Accounts Payable. Will work with other campus partners as needed. Teamwork, collaboration, and effective communication both across the University and with other development staff, are essential.

Principal Accountabilities

Working closely with the Director of Administration, the Finance Coordinator primarily provides financial administrative support, including bookkeeping, entering requisitions, account reconciliation across the entire department. The role assists with managing and monitoring staff expenses to ensure the timely completion of expense reports. It supports the procurement process, including vendor selection, contract negotiation, and purchase order management, ensuring that all expenditures align with approved budget guidelines and university financial policies and procedures. Responsibilities include assisting with the preparation of financial reports and summaries for review by the Director of Administration and senior leadership, as well as assisting with the development of DAR’s annual budget and audits. The Finance Coordinator may also help to identify opportunities for cost savings and efficiencies within the department’s financial operations.

Core Competencies

  • Excellent administrative, bookkeeping, communication, and time management skills.
  • Attention to detail and accuracy in financial record-keeping and reporting.
  • Strong analytical skills, with the ability to interpret financial data and work with data to inform reporting and task completion.
  • Ability to adhere to standard operating procedures to ensure compliance with financial policies and procedures.
  • Ability to navigate internal processes and structures to problem-solve, take initiative, and contribute to a culture of collaboration, accountability, and excellence.
  • Ability to work collaboratively and independently with purpose and accuracy in a fast-paced environment; and
  • Ability to exercise independent judgment and a high degree of discretion.

Minimum Requirements

Education: Associate’s or Bachelor’s degree preferred, or equivalent work experience

  • Minimum three (3) years of experience in finance, accounting, or bookkeeping
  • Excellent computer skills, including Microsoft Suite, excel and budgeting software, familiarity with Workday preferred
  • Excellent communication and interpersonal skills

Salary Range: $65,000 - $80,000
