title: Cleaning and Waste Cluster Coordinator FIFA Women’s World Cup 2027TM
description:
FIFA has established a Local FIFA Subsidiary in Brazil to work together with FIFA Zurich to deliver the FIFA Women’s World Cup 2027™ (FWWC2027) hosted in South America in Brazil. Please submit your CV in English, as it will be reviewed by an international team.

Job Description

The position

The Cleaning and Waste Management Coordinator will support the Senior Cleaning and Waste Management Manager in the planning, operational readiness, implementation, and monitoring of cleaning and waste management operations across FIFA Official Sites. The role supports waste minimisation by reviewing and assessing procurement and service contracts and contributes to achieving defined waste diversion targets.

The position is execution-focused and site-oriented, responsible for supporting readiness planning, coordinating day-to-day operations, and monitoring service delivery during test events and tournament operations. The CLW Coordinator plays a key role in translating strategic and functional requirements into practical, on-the-ground execution, ensuring operational continuity, compliance with FIFA requirements, and the timely identification and resolution of issues at the venue level.

The ideal candidate will combine expertise in event operations, sustainable cleaning, and waste management with strong project management skills. This role will focus on optimizing operational efficiency, ensuring stakeholder satisfaction, and minimizing environmental impact while adhering to FIFA’s stringent standards.

Key responsibilities

Planning & Operational Readiness

  • Support the development and readiness planning of cleaning and waste management operational plans across stadiums and other FIFA Official Sites.
  • Contribute to Service Level Agreement (SLA) development and alignment with Functional Area (FA) leads, ensuring requirements are clearly defined, operationally feasible, and venue-ready.
  • Support Service Level Requirement (SLR) alignment with stadium facility management teams, ensuring consistency with existing venue operations, infrastructure, and constraints.
  • Participate in readiness assessments, site walk-throughs, and test events to validate operational plans, staffing levels, infrastructure, and service flows.

Operational Coordination & Delivery

  • Coordinate day-to-day cleaning and waste management operations in line with approved operational plans, service levels, and schedules.
  • Support match-day, non-match-day, and peak-load operations to ensure service continuity and operational effectiveness.
  • Monitor contractor performance on site and report deviations, risks, and non-compliance to the Senior Cleaning and Waste Management Manager.

Sustainable Waste Operations & Infrastructure

title: Venue Design Manager FIFA Women’s World Cup 2027TM
description:
FIFA has established a Local FIFA Subsidiary in Brazil to work together with FIFA Zurich to deliver the biggest women’s sporting event in the world, the FIFA Women’s World Cup 2027™ (“FWWC2027”) that for the first time ever, is hosted in South America in Brazil. Now is your time to be part of the workforce that is creating this unique and unforgettable experience.

Please submit your CV in English, as it will be reviewed by an international team.

Job Description

The position

The Venue Design Manager reports to FIFA27 Head of Infrastructure & Technical Services and FIFA Senior Venue Design Manager, serving as a key member of the FIFA27 Operations team in close collaboration with the Venue Management team and other stakeholders.

The FIFA Women’s World Cup 2027™ requires venue design of as a key central delivery to fully integrate and visually represent all operations, legacy information and complementary structures required for the tournament. The Venue Design Manager is responsible for leading and implementing the venue design from block planning through to final design across a cluster of official FIFA stadiums and venues.

Role to transition into onsite Venue Overlay Manager during final Event.

Key responsibilities

Raw Data Management

  • Reception, validation and conversion of raw data into clean base CADs

Application of FIFA Drawing Standards:

  • Drawing updates according to FIFA standards and templates (layers, colour codes, line styles, annotation, legends, layouts, naming conventions etc.)

Drawing Updates:

  • Integration of operational content (space allocation, perimeters, flow data, capacities, space tags), legacy information (base infrastructure, legacy usage/annotation/signage) and complementary structures (fences, commodities, FF&E layouts etc.) as required.

Application of BIM 360 workflows:

  • Management and interaction of central database for drawing development, communication, change requests and publications.

Implementation of Space Requirements:

  • Application of requirements according to FIFA Event Platform (EP) and venue limitations.

Drawing Publications:

  • Delivery of drawings sets according to inspections and project timelines (site plans, levels, seating maps, pitch plans, catwalks, sections, detailed layouts etc.)

Ongoing Collaboration:

  • Continuous collaboration and support for Venue Management and FIFA Functional Areas.
  • Collaborate with the Technical Services and Overlay teams, Functional Areas, stadium authorities, and other stakeholders to define, optimize and validate solutions, ensuring technical requirements are accurately reflected in designs and BoQs.

Your profile

  • Degree in architecture, engineering, urban planning or a related field.
  • Minimum 5 years’ experience managing multi-venue overlay projects, from design to delivery, preferably for major sporting events (e.g., FIFA, Olympic Games).
  • Proficiency in AutoCAD, BIM 360, Adobe Creative Cloud and Microsoft Office tools.
  • Strong technical knowledge in temporary infrastructure and spatial planning.
  • Excellent organisational, coordination, and communication skills.
  • Strong analytical and problem-solving skills with the ability to assess and implement effective solutions.
  • Excellent drawing skills and attention to detail
  • Ability to work under pressure, manage competing priorities, and deliver to tight deadlines.
  • Knowledge of local construction regulations and permitting processes in host country (desirable).
    Right to work in Brazil.
  • Fluent in English (spoken and written)
  • Fluent in Portuguese (spoken and written)
  • Ability to re-locate to Rio de Janeiro.

About FIFA Women’s World Cup 2027

The FIFA Women’s World Cup™ is the greatest women’s sporting event on the planet, showcasing the best players in the world on the biggest stage. In 2027, history will be made as Brazil welcomes the tournament to South America for the first time ever.

This landmark event will unite the world through an unprecedented celebration of women’s football, inspiring billions of fans across the globe. As we prepare to host teams and supporters from every corner of the world, we’re looking for passionate, talented individuals to be part of history and help deliver an unforgettable tournament.

Join us and play your role in making FIFA Women’s World Cup 2027™ a truly extraordinary experience that celebrates and elevates women’s football.

title: Head of Competition Management and Team Services FIFA Women’s World Cup 2027TM
description:
Job Description

The position

The Head of Competition Management and Team Services shall have dual reporting to the Team Services and Competition Management departments in FIFA HQ Zurich and to the Executive Operations Director. Under the leadership of the FIFA HQ team, they shall ensure the successful management and implementation of the Team Services and Competition Management projects for the FIFA Women’s World Cup™ (“FWWC”).

The Head of Competition Management and Team Services will work together with the Team Services and Competition Management Team in FIFA HQ Zurich to ensure:

  1. the best possible standard of team facilities can be provided for the tournament across Brazil
  2. the best possible standard of Competition and Match Operations can be delivered by the Competition Management team at the tournament.
  3. efficient and smooth team and competition operations can be put in place by the Team Services and Competition Management team jointly with the relevant functional areas before and during the tournament.

Key responsibilities

  • Implement the Team Services project, under the direction of the FIFA Team Services department in FIFA HQ Zurich
  • Implement the Competitions projec, under the direction of the FIFA Competition Management department in FIFA HQ Zurich
  • Lead and manage the (FIFA27) Competition Management and Team Services sub-division which includes Team Services, Competition Management, Training Site Infrastructure and Referees Management
  • Be responsible for the LFS (FIFA27) parts of project management for Competition Management & Team Services
  • Develop the LFS’ (FIFA27) Competition Management & Team Services budget, under the guidance of the FIFA Team Services and FIFA Competition Management departments, and regularly review and report to also ensure alignment
  • Work closely with the relevant governmental and non-governmental institutions, the national, regional and local football community in all matters related to Competition Management and Team Services (under the guidance of the FIFA HQ Zurich team)
  • Represent Competition Management and Team Services at required key and strategic meetings as well as site inspections when necessary
  • Ensure overall efficient communication channels to all other functional areas within the LFS (FIFA27) as well as to external partners
  • Overseeing the planning & delivery of all competition related events, such as FIFA test events, the Draw, the Team Seminar and Team Workshop as well as FIFA Refereeing’s seminars and workshops, in close collaboration with the FIFA counterparts focusing on the delivery part of the Local Entity;
  • Oversee and supervise the recruitment, training, management of the Competition Management & Team Services team members in Brazil
  • Collaborate with the Infrastructure & Technical Services team on all stadium and team equipment requirements (i.e., Team Materials, Field of Play Equipment, Training Site Equipment) to ensure procurement, delivery, and placement.
  • Be responsible for reporting on a regular basis to the FWWC Senior Management Team
  • Team Services specific (under the leadership of FIFA HQ Zurich):
    • Oversee the delivery of all team facilities according to the FWWC Hosting Requirements;
    • Oversee the planning, coordination and implementation of all services to be delivered to the teams according to FIFA regulations, policies and guidelines;
    • Ensure consistency in terms of levels of services and standards across all Host Cities;
    • Be responsible for the planning and implementation of all team/referees’ operations with focus on the coordination with the local parties;
    • Overview and supervise FIFA Team Services and Refereeing staff inspections as well as the teams’ inspection visits in Brazil as required;
    • Ensure support for the FIFA Refereeing team on any pre-tournament organised seminars and workshops.
    • Manage all LFS (FIFA27) Team Services staffing – including recruitment, preparing policies & procedures, training and administration requirements, integration into stadium staffing teams – in the lead-up to the FWWC
  • Competition Management specific (under the leadership of FIFA HQ Zurich):
    • Oversee the successful operational coordination and delivery of Competition Management, according to the guidance given by FIFA HQ Zurich;
    • Monitor and ensure all stadium competition areas construction/refurbishment are in alignment with FIFA Hosting Requirements, in conjunction with FIFA27 Venue Management;
    • Plan and delivery of competition and stadium readiness exercises and training materials
    • Prepare written reports and presentations on the progress of Competition Management matters
    • Manage all LFS (FIFA27)
    • Competition Management staffing – including recruitment, preparing policies & procedures, training and administration requirements, integration into stadium staffing teams – in the lead-up to the FWWC

Your profile

  • A minimum sports event management experience of 10 years, ideally on an international level in either the Team Services area or the Competition Management area or both
  • Extensive and well-founded international football knowledge
  • Extensive knowledge of event and competition/match operations as well as sport facility operations
  • Strong knowledge of event planning and event project management processes
  • Strong administrative and IT skills including MS Office (Word, Excel, PowerPoint)
  • Ability to effectively monitor organizational performance and implement decisive corrective actions
  • Strong management and leadership skills
  • Right to work in Brazil.
  • Fluent in English (spoken and written)
  • Fluent in Portuguese (spoken and written)
  • Ability to re-locate to Rio de Janeiro.

About FIFA Women’s World Cup 2027

The FIFA Women’s World Cup™ is the greatest women’s sporting event on the planet, showcasing the best players in the world on the biggest stage. In 2027, history will be made as Brazil welcomes the tournament to South America for the first time ever.

This landmark event will unite the world through an unprecedented celebration of women’s football, inspiring billions of fans across the globe. As we prepare to host teams and supporters from every corner of the world, we’re looking for passionate, talented individuals to be part of history and help deliver an unforgettable tournament.

Join us and play your role in making FIFA Women’s World Cup 2027™ a truly extraordinary experience that celebrates and elevates women’s football.

A NTS (Nova Transportadora do Sudeste S/A – NTS) transporta gás natural por meio de um sólido sistema de gasodutos, conectando a região mais industrializada do Brasil com segurança e confiabilidade. São mais de 2.000 quilômetros de gasodutos ligando os estados do Rio de Janeiro, Minas Gerais e São Paulo ao gasoduto Bolívia-Brasil, aos terminais de GNL e às plantas de processamento de gás.

Nossos Valores

  • Respeito à vida e ao meio ambiente : Nosso compromisso é com a segurança dos nossos funcionários e das comunidades e com a preservação do meio ambiente por onde passamos.
  • Integridade : Atuamos com transparência e comprometimento em todas nossas relações, nos pautando pela legalidade.
  • Foco em resultado : Não nos encantamos com sofisticações desnecessárias. Concentramos nossos esforços no alcance das metas e no foco em resultados.
  • Postura de dono : Olhar além do resultado imediato e tomar a melhor decisão para a empresa é uma atitude de todos os nossos funcionários.

Descrição da Vaga

Estamos em busca de um(a) Analista Sênior de Gente e Gestão (HRBP) para integrar o time da NTS. Essa pessoa será responsável por implementar estratégias e diretrizes da área, conduzindo os processos de Gente com foco em promover um ambiente saudável, colaborativo e orientado para entregas de excelência.

Buscamos alguém com perfil estratégico e relacional, que atuará como Business Partner, apoiando líderes na tomada de decisões, impulsionando a cultura organizacional e contribuindo para o desenvolvimento das equipes.

Responsabilidades

  • Atuar como Business Partner para diferentes áreas da companhia, oferecendo consultoria interna em temas de Gente & Gestão;
  • Realizar pesquisas de satisfação e promover ações de melhoria contínua;
  • Disseminar políticas, normas, procedimentos e processos organizacionais;
  • Aprovar requisições de abertura de novas posições e alinhar perfil das vagas com gestores e equipe de Recrutamento e Seleção;
  • Participar dos processos seletivos, apoiando gestores na tomada de decisão;
  • Apoiar a construção e acompanhamento de Planos de Desenvolvimento Individual (PDI);
  • Identificar e viabilizar ações de desenvolvimento para equipes;
  • Conduzir o ciclo de carreira e sucessão, facilitando comitês e aplicando metodologias;
  • Acompanhar processos de desligamento com foco em cuidado e alinhamento organizacional;
  • Definir diretrizes e interfaces necessárias para o processo de desligamento;
  • Monitorar indicadores de performance das áreas atendidas e tratar desvios identificados;
  • Apoiar a área de Remuneração com análises estratégicas e ações voltadas à atração, retenção e reconhecimento de talentos;
  • Elaborar, atualizar e gerenciar normas, instruções e procedimentos;
  • Alinhar conteúdos da área de Gente & Gestão às necessidades das áreas de negócio.

Requisitos

  • Ensino Superior completo.
  • Especialização em Gestão empresarial, Gestão de Pessoas ou áreas afins.
  • Pacote Office avançado.
  • Experiência comprovada como Business Partner para área Corporativas.
  • Inglês intermediário.

Como se preparar para o processo seletivo

  • Pesquise sobre a NTS: Entenda a história, valores e missão da NTS. Visite o site oficial e leia notícias recentes.
  • Revisão de CV: Garanta que seu currículo esteja atualizado e reflita suas habilidades e experiências relevantes.
  • Prepare-se para perguntas: Pense em exemplos concretos de situações em que demonstrou suas habilidades e competências.
  • Conheça a vaga: Entenda as responsabilidades e requisitos da posição para alinhar suas respostas às expectativas da empresa.

Etapas do Processo Seletivo

  • Entrevista com time de Gente: Para discutir mais sobre a empresa, aderência à vaga e expectativas.
  • Entrevista com o Gestor e Business Partner: Para conversar sobre aspectos do dia a dia, conhecimento técnico e carreira.
  • Entrevista com as Interfaces: Coordenadores e clientes internos que terão contato próximo com a área.
  • Entrevista com o Coordenadores ou Gerentes da área: Última etapa para conhecer a liderança e alinhar expectativas finais.

Por que trabalhar conosco?

Na NTS, você encontra um ambiente dinâmico, inclusivo e acolhedor, onde as pessoas são valorizadas e têm espaço para crescer. Acreditamos no poder da diversidade, da colaboração e do desenvolvimento contínuo.

Oferecemos oportunidades reais de aprendizado e evolução profissional, com programas estruturados e incentivo ao protagonismo de carreira.

Nosso pacote de benefícios é completo e pensado para cuidar de você em todas as fases da vida:

  • Plano de saúde de qualidade
  • Previdência privada
  • Vale refeição/alimentação (Swile)
  • Auxílio farmácia
  • Auxílio creche
  • Day-off de aniversário
  • TotalPass
  • Participação nos Lucros e Resultados (PLR)

Aqui, você será parte de uma empresa sólida, com propósito claro e que valoriza o bem-estar, o respeito.

Venha transportar o futuro conosco!

title: Analista Performance e Gestão
description:
Overview

Com experiência em gestão de negócios desde 1955, a WLM atua de forma estratégica e integrada nos segmentos automotivo, do agronegócio, de energia e de soluções sustentáveis, consolidando-se como um grupo sólido, diversificado e em constante evolução. O principal foco dos negócios da WLM é a comercialização de produtos e serviços da marca Scania, incluindo caminhões pesados e extrapesados, chassis para ônibus rodoviários e urbanos, venda de peças genuínas, além da prestação de serviços de manutenção corretiva e preventiva e assistência técnica especializada. No segmento de concessionárias Scania, a WLM está presente em mais de 20 pontos no país, atendendo seis estados brasileiros, por meio das operações Equipo (RJ), Itaipu (MG), Itaipu Norte (PA), Quinta Roda (SP) e Supermac (AM e RR). No segmento do agronegócio, por meio de suas controladas Fartura (Sul do Pará) e Itapura (Norte do Mato Grosso, Sul de Minas e região de Campinas/SP), a WLM atua nas atividades de cria, recria e engorda de bovinos, além da produção e comercialização de café, soja e milho. Com forte compromisso com a sustentabilidade, suas atividades produtivas são executadas com foco nas melhores práticas de preservação da fauna e flora nativas, bem como no cuidado com a água e o solo. Em 2025, a WLM anunciou a aquisição de 60% da CHP Brasil, empresa referência em geração distribuída e eficiência energética. Com essa aquisição, o grupo amplia sua presença estratégica, diversifica seu portfólio e dá um passo significativo em direção ao futuro, reforçando seu compromisso com a sustentabilidade e com a criação de novas oportunidades de negócio no setor de energia.

Como parte dessa estratégia de inovação, sustentabilidade e diversificação dos negócios, nasce a Ekotruck, uma startup criada dentro do Grupo WLM com o propósito de oferecer sempre a melhor solução em peças e serviços para seus clientes. A empresa expande o foco do grupo por meio da reciclagem de caminhões, da oferta de peças alternativas, componentes remanufaturados e contratos de manutenção, com forte uso de tecnologia. Seu foco principal está na redução do TCO (Custo Total de Propriedade) dos clientes, no fortalecimento da economia circular e na geração de eficiência operacional sustentável. A localização estratégica das unidades da WLM permite uma atuação com ampla cobertura geográfica, garantindo agilidade, qualidade e excelência no atendimento. A holding do grupo está localizada no Rio de Janeiro e conta com uma filial corporativa em Contagem/MG. Vem acelerar a sua carreira com o Grupo WLM!

Confira abaixo as atribuições e vantagens da vaga de Analista de Performance Gestão e venha fazer parte desse time de sucesso.

Responsabilidades

  • Realiza mapeamento e análise de processos das diversas áreas da empresa, identificando oportunidades de melhoria e propondo automações e ações para aumento de eficiência.
  • Auxilia na implantação, padronização e monitoramento dos KPIs (indicadores).
  • Acompanha a implantação das ferramentas de gestão de resultados, através de reuniões junto às áreas (daily e pulse).
  • Apoia as equipes no planejamento das iniciativas / projetos com follow-ups conforme diretriz definida.

Requisitos

  • Ensino Superior Completo em Administração, Engenharias, Gestão da Qualidade ou áreas afins.
  • Excel Avançado.
  • Disponibilidade para viagens.
  • Especialização em Gestão de Processos e conhecimento de BMN e Bizagi será um diferencial.

Benefícios

  • Ticket Alimentação – pensado para garantir praticidade no cuidado com a sua casa e família.
  • Refeição no local – para refeições mais práticas e tranquilas no seu dia a dia.
  • Vale Transporte – para apoiar seu deslocamento no trajeto casa x trabalho x casa.
  • Assistência Médica – cuidando da sua saúde e de quem você ama.
  • Assistência Odontológica – cuidando do seu sorriso e de toda a sua família.
  • Cartão Farmácia – facilidade e conveniência para cuidar da sua saúde e bem-estar.
  • Seguro de Vida em Grupo e Assistência Funeral – proteção e segurança para você e sua família em momentos delicados.
  • Wellhub (Gympass) – incentivo à prática de atividades físicas e ao bem-estar.
  • Telemedicina: Dra. AON | Conexa Saúde – apoio à sua saúde com praticidade e rapidez, sempre que precisar.
  • Parceria Open English – curso de idiomas com condições exclusivas para colaboradores.
  • Programa de Desenvolvimento Educacional (PDE) – apoio financeiro e institucional para formações, cursos ou especializações alinhadas às suas atividades e ao desenvolvimento da empresa.
  • Premiação anual – reconhecimento pelo seu desempenho.

title: Assistente Contábil I | Negócios
description:
Descrição da vaga
Com uma trajetória de 95 anos, a Americanas S.A está presente na vida de milhões de brasileiros.
Nossas +1600 lojas físicas estão distribuídas por todos os estados do Brasil, em mais de 800 cidades, levando nossos produtos e serviços a mais de 40 milhões de clientes em todo o país.
A área de Contabilidade é responsável pelo registro, controle e análise das operações financeiras da companhia, garantindo conformidade com normas contábeis e suporte às áreas de negócio. Os principais desafios incluem lidar com alto volume de informações, prazos rigorosos de fechamento e constante atualização frente às normas contábeis e processos internos.

Responsabilidades e atribuições

  • Atuar na classificação, registro, análise, mensuração e conciliação contábil de todo o patrimônio da companhia;
  • Auxiliar na execução de projetos e atividades da área;
  • Trazer propostas de melhoria e inovação para as atividades do dia a dia;
  • Estabelecer relacionamento consistente com as demais áreas da companhia;
  • Auxiliar no processo de auditoria interna e externa;
  • Atuar tempestivamente na aprovação de chamados e contabilizações.

Requisitos e qualificações

  • Conhecimento em Contabilidade Básica;
  • Domínio do Pacote Office;
  • Noções de tratamento de dados;
  • Experiência com ERP contábil.

Será um diferencial, caso você possua

  • Formação Completa ou em andamento em Ciências Contábeis;
  • Excel avançado, Power Automate e Looker;
  • Conhecimento em SAP;
  • Experiência no ramo do Varejo.

Informações adicionais

Nossos benefícios:

  • Vale Refeição;
  • Plano de saúde Bradesco;
  • Plano odontológico Amil;
  • Wellhub;
  • Seguro de vida;
  • Fazemos nossa proposta salarial de acordo com o nosso plano de cargos e salários, sua pretensão salarial e avaliação técnica;
  • Somos uma Empresa Cidadã: 180 dias de licença maternidade e 20 dias licença paternidade;
  • Descontos em nossas lojas físicas, após o período de experiência;
  • Ambiente colaborativo: perfeito pra ensinar e aprender muito.

QUEM SOMOS

Quem Somos: Somos a Americanas, uma das maiores varejistas do país, com mais de 95 anos de história. Nossa marca, amada pelos brasileiros, tem o propósito de resolver a vida das famílias de maneira simples e descomplicada. A integração das mais de 1.600 lojas, presentes em todos os estados, e um e-commerce que complementa a experiência do físico nos permitem a realização de uma estratégia de vendas multicanal e eficiente, com foco na geração de caixa e na rentabilidade. Venha construir o futuro com a gente!

Nosso Jeito

Nossa cultura é centrada no cliente, e buscamos constantemente soluções para aprimorar sua experiência. Valorizamos um jeito de trabalhar simples e descomplicado, que realmente gera impacto positivo na vida das pessoas. Aqui, incentivamos o trabalho em equipe e a troca de ideias, pois acreditamos que é assim que crescemos juntos, tanto como profissionais quanto como pessoas.

Valores e Propósito

Nosso propósito é resolver a vida das pessoas, de maneira simples e descomplicada, guiada por valores autênticos e que representem a nossa gente. Buscamos entregar resultados com integridade, sempre servindo o cliente da melhor forma; priorizamos a conveniência em cada experiência, seja nas lojas, no site ou no coração de milhões de famílias; valorizamos a pluralidade e a resiliência, além de reconhecer e cuidar das nossas pessoas. Acima de tudo, nos comprometemos a ter um impacto positivo em tudo o que fazemos.

Diversidade e inclusão

A Americanas S.A. acredita que diferentes perspectivas enriquecem o ambiente de trabalho. Por isso, temos o objetivo de promover um lugar cada vez mais diverso, inclusivo e acolhedor. Estamos construindo a cada dia uma cultura com base no respeito e valorização das diferenças, encorajando as pessoas a serem quem elas são, independente de gênero, etnia, raça, orientação sexual, religião ou deficiência. Nós acreditamos na integração das diversas culturas e tradições do Brasil, e queremos refletir a riqueza e a pluralidade do nosso país. Todas as nossas oportunidades são trabalhadas com base nesse princípio.

O Time Do Renda Extra - Ton

Nosso propósito é suportar o canal de vendas dos nossos consultores TON. Nosso programa Renda Extra é um programa de indicação onde clientes podem indicar novos clientes, assim como nossos consultores que usam o canal como principal fonte de renda. Terá a missão de analisar e acompanhar os resultados do time do Renda Extra, identificando os principais desvios e traçando planos de ação para recuperação. O Que Esperamos De Você

  • Familiaridade com ferramentas de BI e visualização de dados (DataStudio, Power BI, Tableau, etc.);
  • Capacidade de análise de grandes volumes de dados, extraindo insights para o negócio;
  • Entendimento de métricas de vendas, metas comerciais e performance de canais.

title: Manager, Volunteer Operations FIFA Women’s World Cup 2027TM
description:
FIFA has established a Local FIFA Subsidiary in Brazil to work together with FIFA Zurich to deliver the biggest women’s sporting event in the world, the FIFA Women’s World Cup 2027™ (“FWWC2027”) that for the first time ever, is hosted in South America in Brazil. Now is your time to be part of the workforce that is creating this unique and unforgettable experience.

Please submit your CV in English, as it will be reviewed by an international team.

Job Description

The position

Reporting to the Senior Volunteer Manager – FIFA27, the Volunteer Operations Manager will help bring together and manage thousands of volunteers across the 8 Host Cities.

In this role, you will support the planning and delivery of the Volunteer Programme, especially in the important areas of attracting, recruiting, training, and supporting volunteers during the Tournament. You will work closely with many internal teams and with the Host Cities of the FIFA Women’s World Cup Brazil 2027™. The role will work closely with FIFA Zurich to ensure consistency and accountability.

Your main responsibilities will include managing key projects from start to finish. This includes organising volunteer recruitment activities, operational organisation of volunteer trainings, and overseeing the design and set-up of Volunteer Centres in each Host City. You will also create clear operational plans to ensure we meet programme milestones and deliver a consistent, high-quality volunteer experience in all 8 Host Cities.

We are looking for someone with strong experience in volunteer operations, who understands the challenges and opportunities of a major global event, and who has practical experience working in Brazil.

Key responsibilities

  • Plan, coordinate, and support the daily operations of the Volunteer Programme while helping deliver several connected projects – including setting up volunteer services such as transport, catering, rewards and recognition.
  • Work on important parts of the volunteer journey, such as promotional events, recruitment, training, and Tournament-time operations. These projects will develop and change as we get closer to FWWC27.
  • Contribute to headcount planning efforts working closely with all Functional Areas to collect, confirm and combine volunteer requirements.
  • Support Host Cities with planning and running the Volunteer Recruitment Centres, helping us deliver a unified Volunteer Programme across Brazil.
  • Create clear, central plans and processes that help teams work efficiently and ensure volunteers have consistent experience everywhere.
  • Build strong working relationships with Functional Areas, Host City teams, stadium authorities, and service providers to ensure smooth project delivery.
  • Participation in venue operation planning and assisting in the central coordination of volunteer data capture and management.
    FIFA Women’s World Cup Brazil 2027™ Job Description.
  • Help develop volunteer policies and procedures that follow FIFA standards and guidelines.
  • Plan and run readiness workshops for the FWWC27 Volunteer Management team to ensure all locations are prepared for operations.
  • Manage procurement processes (including RFI and RFP) for all services needed for volunteer operations from launch through Tournament time, in coordination with FIFA Zurich.
  • Work with Functional Areas to ensure all volunteer-related items are correctly counted, prepared, and delivered at each stage of the volunteer journey. Support Host Cities in delivering their responsibilities on time and in line with the central plans.

Your profile

  • Education: Master in Sports Management or Event Management or Project Management preferred.
  • Experience: 5 years + Proven experience in leading and managing large-scale volunteer programmes including fit for purpose attraction, recruitment, engagement and tournament time operational tactics.
  • Strong understanding of effective volunteer management best practices.
  • Solid knowledge of project management principles and methodologies, with the ability to plan, coordinate, and deliver multiple workstreams simultaneously.
  • High level of proficiency in Microsoft Office applications (Word, Excel, PowerPoint).
  • Experience working with a Volunteer Management System (e.g. Rosterfy) or similar platforms is highly desirable.
  • Demonstrated ability to develop beneficial working relationships with internal and external stakeholder.
  • Strong organisational and time-management skills, with a proven ability to prioritise tasks, multitask effectively, and meet deadlines in a fast-paced environment.
  • Experience operating in complex, multi-stakeholder environments, with the flexibility and resilience to adapt to change and manage competing priorities.
  • Excellent communication skills in both English and Portuguese (written and verbal), with the ability to communicate clearly across diverse teams and cultures.
  • Creative, with aptitude to adapt, anticipate risks and remain solution orientated.
  • A collaborative and inclusive team player, capable of working effectively with colleagues both on-site and remotely, while fostering a positive and respectful working environment.
  • Right to work in Brazil.
  • Ability to re-locate to Rio de Janeiro.

Start date: 01 March (tentative or to be agreed)

About FIFA Women’s World Cup 2027

The FIFA Women’s World Cup™ is the greatest women’s sporting event on the planet, showcasing the best players in the world on the biggest stage. In 2027, history will be made as Brazil welcomes the tournament to South America for the first time ever.

This landmark event will unite the world through an unprecedented celebration of women’s football, inspiring billions of fans across the globe. As we prepare to host teams and supporters from every corner of the world, we’re looking for passionate, talented individuals to be part of history and help deliver an unforgettable tournament.

Join us and play your role in making FIFA Women’s World Cup 2027™ a truly extraordinary experience that celebrates and elevates’s football.

title: Accreditation Documentation & Training Materials Manager
description:
Overview

Department: Tournament and Venue Operations

Location: Brazil

FIFA has established a Local FIFA Subsidiary in Brazil to work together with FIFA Zurich to deliver the biggest women’s sporting event in the world, the FIFA Women’s World Cup 2027™ ("FWWC2027") that for the first time ever is hosted in South America in Brazil. Now is your time to be part of the workforce that is creating this unique and unforgettable experience.

Please submit your CV in English, as it will be reviewed by an international team.

The Position

The Accreditation programme requires clear, consistent, and accurate documentation and training materials to support staff, volunteers, and stakeholders across all venues and operational environments.

The Accreditation Documentation & Training Materials Manager plays a central operational role in coordinating, developing, and delivering accreditation documentation and training content that supports consistent accreditation delivery throughout the tournament lifecycle.

Reporting to the FIFA27 Accreditation Senior Manager / Project Lead, the Accreditation Documentation & Training Materials Manager is responsible for the coordination, development, and delivery of accreditation documentation and training materials in support of tournament operations.

Working within established FIFA accreditation policies and frameworks, and in close collaboration with FIFA Zurich Accreditation, Accreditation Operations, Client Group Management, Systems, Security, and Venue teams, the role ensures that accreditation information and training materials are accurate, up‑to‑date, and accessible to all relevant audiences.

This role focuses on content coordination, operational enablement, and quality assurance.

Responsibilities

Key responsibilities

  • Accreditation Documentation & Content Management: Coordinate the development and maintenance of accreditation documentation for multiple audiences, including management, accreditation staff, volunteers, and external stakeholders.
  • Support the production of accreditation guidelines, manuals, process documents, and instructional materials.
  • Ensure all documentation aligns with approved FIFA accreditation policies, procedures, and terminology.
  • Coordinate reviews, updates, and version control of accreditation materials throughout the project lifecycle.
  • Training Material Development & Delivery: Coordinate the development and delivery of accreditation training materials across multiple formats (e.g. presentations, instructional videos, train‑the‑trainer content, digital learning tools).
  • Identify the most appropriate media and formats to support different training needs and stakeholder groups.
  • Support the planning and implementation of accreditation training programmes in coordination with Accreditation Operations, Systems and Client Group Management.
  • Review and refine training materials based on feedback from events and tournament operations.
  • Operational Support & Cross‑Functional Coordination: Support centralised issue resolution processes by ensuring relevant accreditation guidance and reference materials are available and current.
  • Work across Accreditation workstreams to support operational deliverables where documentation or training inputs are required.
  • Support information sharing across workstreams to ensure consistent understanding of accreditation processes and updates.
  • Quality Assurance & Compliance: Ensure accuracy, clarity, and consistency of all accreditation documentation and training materials.
  • Support compliance with data protection, access control, and accreditation governance requirements.
  • Ensure changes to processes or procedures are clearly communicated and reflected across all documentation.

Your profile

  • University degree or equivalent in Event Management, Sports Administration, Operations, or a related field.
  • Minimum 4+ years of experience in accreditation, event operations, training, documentation, or related roles within major events.
  • Experience working with accreditation or access control systems is an advantage.
  • Experience working in fast‑paced, multicultural environments.
  • Strong organisational and coordination skills.
  • Excellent written communication and technical documentation skills.
  • Experience developing training and instructional materials.
  • High attention to detail and commitment to accuracy.
  • Ability to manage multiple priorities and stakeholders.
  • Proficient in Microsoft Office and common collaboration and content creation tools.
  • Right to work in Brazil.
  • Fluent in English (spoken and written)
  • Fluent in Portuguese (spoken and written)
  • Ability to relocate to Rio de Janeiro.

A Leve Saúde é uma operadora de saúde carioca que nasceu com o propósito de transformar a forma como o cuidado em saúde é oferecido no Brasil. Acreditamos que cuidar vai muito além de oferecer planos — é construir relações, escutar de verdade e estar presente na jornada de cada pessoa.

Overview

Marine and Energy Distributor Account Manager | Full time

Location: Brazil, Rio de Janeiro

Job code: RQ

What You Will Do

Responsible for managing local distributor partners/intermediaries/resellers. Accountable for the development as well as the execution of the indirect sales strategy and delivering financial performance targets through robust Joint Business Plans and monitoring performance to ensure long-term sustainable value for the company.

Drive sustainable growth in the indirect channel by prospecting and acquiring new distributors in the territory to achieve a targeted footprint of high-quality distributor partners aligned with the business strategy. Provide training on products and services, coach third parties, and ensure the indirect channel salesforce is capable and equipped to represent the GME business to customers.

What You Will Deliver

Execute the annual and multi-year strategic plans for indirect sales. Develop channel strategies to improve the value chain and ensure excellent standards and delivery to customers. Achieve financial targets through regional delivery and price interventions as defined by our competitive strategy (e.g., Joint Business Plans, Distributor Offers, Upselling, indirect growth, SmartGains).

Develop, agree (internally and externally) and implement a Joint Business Plan with the distributor/channel partner, covering in-year and longer-term views. Provide ongoing support across its contents, including sales performance, sales capability, customer offer deployment, HSSE and ethics & compliance.

Influence resource allocations of the third-party partner to fulfill strategic priorities within the territory. Coach and motivate third-party sales teams to execute standardized customer offers and programs. Provide resources such as distributor academy, marketing collateral, digital tools, and training to develop capability and increase distributor self-sufficiency.

Promote and lead delivery through the SmartGains framework, manage KPI implementation, and ensure distributors have the capabilities to execute with excellence. Support distributors in building value-case testimonials and share best practices.

Make joint customer calls with Platinum distributors to support capability development and SmartGains implementation. Develop customer and market insights to enable brand distinctiveness and feed the offer pipeline. Lead virtual customer account teams with support from Customer Operations, GBS, and Technical Service teams, with clear delegation of responsibilities.

Experience & Requirements

Experience Required

Understanding of shipping, oil & gas market and global dynamics, trends, regulatory environment desirable.

B2B sales management experience with a track record of delivering sales targets and performance.

Mandatory proficiency in Spanish. English proficiency, Intermediate. This role will cover all South America region, not only Brazil.

  • Ability to develop, maintain and build new relationships with customers, OEMs and industry bodies.
  • Ability to present persuasive offers to senior-level management within the customer’s business.
  • Leverages resources and own networks to achieve goals and objectives.

No direct reports.

title: Cybersecurity Engineer
description:
Here Is What We Offer

  • Health & Wellness: Comprehensive medical, dental, and vision insurance, plus mental health support
  • Work-Life Balance: PTO, paid holidays, flexible work arrangements
  • Financial Wellness: Competitive salary, 403(b) with company match
  • Professional Development: Ongoing training, tuition reimbursement, and career advancement paths
  • Additional Perks: Wellness programs, commuter benefits, and a vibrant company culture

Basic Function

The Cybersecurity Engineer is responsible for protecting the organization's information systems and digital assets by developing, implementing, and maintaining technical security controls. This role includes conducting security assessments, monitoring systems for vulnerabilities or intrusions, and ensuring that the organization’s IT environment remains compliant with industry and regulatory standards such as NIST, ISO/IEC 27001, HIPAA, PCI DSS, and GDPR. The engineer also plays a critical role in incident detection, response, and prevention.

Supervisory Authority

NONE

Nature And Scope

Operating in a dynamic threat landscape, the Cybersecurity Engineer reports to the Senior Director of Cybersecurity and works with other IT, compliance, and business stakeholders. Although not a supervisory role, the Cybersecurity Engineer may guide junior staff or external contractors and lead technical implementation efforts on security‑related projects. The role demands staying up to date on emerging threats, tools, and best practices, and proactively evolving the organization's defenses accordingly.

Principal Accountabilities

  • Conduct vulnerability scans, penetration tests, and security configuration reviews.
  • Evaluate system and application hardening measures using CIS benchmarks and STIGs.
  • Monitor networks and endpoints using tools like SIEM, EDR, and IDS/IPS (e.g., CrowdStrike, Sentinel).
  • Analyze security events and logs to detect, triage, and respond to threats.
  • Deploy, configure, and maintain security tools, including:
    • Firewalls
    • Network Access Control (NAC)
    • Antivirus/Endpoint Protection
    • DLP, CASB, and vulnerability management platforms
  • Develop and enforce cybersecurity policies, standards, and operating procedures.
  • Ensure system compliance with internal policies and external frameworks such as NIST 800‑53, ISO/IEC 27001, and PCI DSS.
  • Develop and deliver training on phishing, password hygiene, and secure computing practices.
  • Support tabletop exercises and simulation drills to test security readiness.
  • Work with DevOps and infrastructure teams to embed security into system architecture.
  • Participate in project reviews to identify and mitigate risks early in the system development lifecycle.

Core Competencies

  • Experience in the following:
    • Windows Server Operating Systems, VMware
    • Core enterprise roles such as Active Directory, Group Policy, CA
    • Bare metal servers and data center configurations
    • Falcon Crowdstrike
    • Microsoft Azure (IaaS, PaaS, SaaS), Office 365, Entra ID, Azure Sentinel
    • Hybrid cloud integrations
    • Authentication protocols
    • Threat Intelligence, Threat Hunting
  • Proficient in securing firewalls, VPNs, and virtual environments (VMware/Hyper‑V).
  • Hands‑on experience with Microsoft Defender Suite, Cisco DNA, and Cisco ISE.
  • Familiar with scripting for automation (e.g., PowerShell, Python) to streamline security operations.
  • Deep knowledge of secure software development lifecycle (SSDLC), DevSecOps principles, and CI/CD pipeline security.
  • Experience implementing TLS, SSL, VPN encryption, HSMs, and certificate lifecycle management.
  • Deep understanding of encryption, PKI, authentication, secure networking, and operating system security across Linux and Windows environments.
  • Proficient in analyzing logs, threat intelligence, and indicators of compromise (IOCs) to drive timely threat mitigation.
  • Ability to translate complex technical findings into actionable recommendations for technical and non‑technical audiences.
  • Methodical and responsive approach to detecting, responding to, and remediating security incidents.
  • Works cross‑functionally with IT, audit, compliance, and legal to promote enterprise‑wide security awareness and enforcement.
  • Careful review of systems, code, and configurations to identify small changes that may indicate large risks.
  • Able to shift priorities rapidly in response to new vulnerabilities, threat campaigns, or business requirements.

Minimum Requirements

A Bachelor's degree from a four‑year college or university in computer science/Information Technology with a security concentration. A master’s degree in business administration is highly desirable. Must have 7–10 years of progressive experience in information security, including a minimum of 5 years in a security engineering role. One or more industry‑recognized certifications such as CISSP, CISM, CCSP, SABSA, TOGAF, AWS Certified Security – Specialty, or Azure Security Engineer Associate is required or strongly preferred. The candidate should demonstrate hands‑on expertise in network and application security architecture, cloud security controls across platforms like Azure, AWS, or GCP, identity and access management (including IAM, SSO, and MFA), and security monitoring tools such as SIEM, SOAR, and EDR. Experience with Zero Trust architecture and secure DevSecOps practices is essential. A solid understanding of key regulatory frameworks and compliance requirements—including GDPR, HIPAA, FERPA, and FISMA—is also required. In addition to technical capabilities, the candidate should possess strong collaboration and critical thinking skills, a sharp attention to detail, and the ability to effectively manage multiple priorities in a fast‑paced environment.

Compliance Salary Range Disclosure

$130,000–$140,000

description:
GUARACAMP!

Há 29 anos, nascemos na Zona Oeste do Rio como uma marca raiz, autêntica como o carioca. Somos o Guaraná Natural mais amado do Rio de Janeiro , e temos orgulho da nossa história de crescimento com os pés no chão, foco em resultado e paixão pelo que fazemos.

Aqui, a gente tem Sangue Verde — orgulho de pertencer e atitude de dono. Cuidamos da empresa como se fosse nossa, percebemos o que precisa ser feito e agimos com senso de urgência.

Fazemos o que tem que ser feito , sem desculpas. Somos gente que arregaça as mangas, vai pra cima e entrega resultado.

Transparência é Lei : jogamos limpo, falamos com clareza e resolvemos as coisas com verdade e respeito.

Acreditamos que Tudo pode ser feito melhor — nada é definitivo, e evoluir é parte da nossa essência.

E, claro, Fazemos mais com menos : valorizamos cada recurso, buscamos eficiência e mantemos a qualidade em tudo que fazemos.

A Guaracamp Disponibiliza vagas para pessoas com Deficiência, conforme Art. 93, Lei 8.213/91 e art 3º e 4º Dec 3.298-99.

OBJETIVO DO CARGO

O Analista de RH será um agente de transformação e suporte que atuará dando apoio a atração, desenvolvimento e engajamento dos colaboradores, sendo essencial para manter um quadro de pessoal qualificado e motivado.

PRINCIPAIS RESPONSABILIDADES

  • Apoio em Processos Seletivos de vagas operacionais: Atuar no ciclo completo de recrutamento e seleção de vagas pontuais em diferentes níveis e áreas, desde a divulgação até a proposta, garantindo o fit cultural dos novos talentos.

title: Oficial Gasista|Hidráulico - H. M. Souza Aguiar
description:
Overview

Esta é a sua porta de entrada para um futuro promissor no maior projeto de modernização de infraestrutura hospitalar do Rio de Janeiro. Ao cadastrar seu currículo, você entra em nossa rede e poderá ser considerado futuramente para todas as vagas que surgirem durante as próximas contratações.

Quem somos?

Smart Hospital: Transformando a saúde com inovação. Somos líderes em construção, reforma e operação de infraestrutura hospitalar, pioneiros em modernizar hospitais por meio de parcerias público-privadas. Em parceria com o Complexo Hospitalar Souza Aguiar, o maior hospital de emergência da América Latina, estamos redefinindo os padrões de atendimento em saúde.

O que buscamos?

Um profissional experiente e dedicado para integrar nossa equipe como Bombeiro Hidráulico Gasista. O profissional será responsável pela instalação, manutenção e reparo de tubulações de água, esgoto e, principalmente, de redes e sistemas de gás em edificações, interpretando projetos e garantindo a segurança e a conformidade técnica das instalações.

Dia a Dia

  • Instalação e reparo de tubulações de água (fria e quente) e esgoto sanitário.
  • Montagem, construção e manutenção de redes e sistemas de gás em edificações, conforme projetos.
  • Interpretação de projetos hidráulicos, sanitários e de gás para a correta implantação dos sistemas.
  • Realização de reparos em canos, vazamentos, sistemas hidráulicos e desobstrução de tubulações e ralos.
  • Montagem, instalação e manutenção de aquecedores, aparelhos a gás e outros equipamentos.
  • Utilização de técnicas e equipamentos especializados para identificar e reparar vazamentos de gás, garantindo a segurança.
  • Execução de testes para verificar a segurança, a ausência de vazamentos e a eficiência das instalações de gás e hidráulicas.
  • Realização de manutenção de primeiro nível em máquinas e equipamentos utilizados durante os serviços.
  • Preparação e organização do local de trabalho, garantindo o cumprimento de procedimentos e normas regulamentadoras de saúde, segurança no trabalho e meio ambiente.

Local de atuação

Complexo Hospitalar Municipal Souza Aguiar | Endereço: Praça da República, 111, Centro, Rio de Janeiro

Horário

Temos 2 modelos de jornadas, 44 horas semanais (Segunda a Sexta) e Plantonista 12x36 (Diurno e Noturno).

Requisitos

O que precisamos que você tenha:

  • Experiência comprovada como Bombeiro Hidráulico/Encanador.
  • Conhecimento e experiência na instalação e manutenção de sistemas de gás (Gasista).
  • Curso de Encanador e Bombeiro Hidráulico (ou formação técnica equivalente).
  • Curso de Gasista.
  • Habilidade na leitura e interpretação de projetos hidráulicos e de sistemas de gás.
  • Conhecimento das normas técnicas e regulamentações aplicáveis à instalações hidráulicas, sanitárias e de gás.
  • Comprometimento com a segurança e com as normas regulamentadoras (NRs).

O Que Vamos Amar Se Você Tiver

  • Proatividade e capacidade de solucionar problemas de forma autônoma.
  • Experiência em soldagem (cobre, aço).
  • Certificações adicionais na área de segurança ou manutenção de equipamentos.
  • Habilidade para trabalhar em equipe e comunicar-se de forma clara.

Benefícios

  • Mobilidade: Cartão Swile com VT (combo mobilidade) para você escolher a melhor forma de chegar ao trabalho.
  • Alimentação: VA/VR (R$ 25,00/dia) com a flexibilidade de um cartão de crédito, para você escolher onde e como se alimentar.
  • Saúde: Plano de saúde, programa Vittude de saúde mental, plano odontológico e Totalpass para cuidar do seu bem-estar físico e mental.
  • Finanças: Descontos diferenciados em folha de pagamento.
  • Day off no aniversário: Proporcionando um dia de descanso para comemorar seu aniversário.
  • Convênio com SESC: Oferece acesso a diversas atividades de lazer e cultura, promovendo a qualidade de vida pra você e sua família.
  • Seguro de vida: Garante a segurança financeira da sua família em caso de imprevistos, proporcionando tranquilidade e proteção.

title: Interpretation Geophysicist
description:
Viridien ( is an advanced technology, digital and Earth data company that pushes the boundaries of science for a more prosperous and sustainable future. With our ingenuity, drive and deep curiosity we discover new insights, innovations, and solutions that efficiently and responsibly resolve complex natural resource, digital, energy transition and infrastructure challenges.

Overview

We are looking for passionate geoscientists to join our Interpretation Team at Viridien. In this role, you will contribute directly to Velocity Model Building (VMB) by performing seismic interpretation and providing essential geological support to Processing and VMB teams. From picking horizons to building velocity scenarios, you will work at the intersection of geology, geophysics, and advanced imaging tools, helping to transform complex seismic data into meaningful insights. Your work will play a critical role in delivering high-quality results to our clients and shaping decisions across energy and earth-data projects.

Responsibilities

  • Perform seismic interpretation for VMB, including horizon picking (unconformities, salt horizons, pre-salt).
  • Create local velocity scenarios.
  • Apply imaging tools, workflows, and data QC (attributes, velocities, maps).
  • Integrate geological and geophysical data for deeper insights.
  • Engage directly with clients to present results and understand their perspectives.

About The Team

You will join a diverse group of interpreters, geologists, and geophysicists who collaborate closely with Processing and VMB teams. Together, we tackle complex challenges, share knowledge, and drive innovation in seismic imaging. At Viridien, collaboration is key — you will be encouraged to bring your ideas forward and grow in a supportive environment.

Qualifications

  • Master’s or PhD in Geophysics, Geology, or related field; or equivalent professional experience in the Oil & Gas industry.
  • Solid background in seismic interpretation, exploration geology, stratigraphy, or basin analysis.
  • Strong geophysical knowledge (seismic attributes, AVO, reservoir characterization, quantitative interpretation, well data QC/processing).
  • Ability to integrate data across scales (well, seismic, potential data).
  • Good understanding of seismic imaging and prospect assessment.
  • Experience with Pre-Salt or Brazilian Equatorial Margin is a plus.
  • Strong analytical and problem-solving mindset.
  • Effective communication and presentation skills in English.
  • Python programming is a plus.

Benefits

  • Competitive salary with performance-based bonus.
  • Relocation package (when applicable).
  • Comprehensive health and dental insurance.
  • Private Pension Plan
  • Meal Voucher
  • Free breakfast and snacks at the office.
  • Shiatsu Therapy at the Office
  • TotalPass Fitness Program
  • Hybrid Work Model (up to 2 remote days per week)
  • Birthday Day Off
  • Christmas Gift Card
  • Educational Assistance and Language Learning Programs
  • Continuous training via the Learning Hub, with both technical and behavioral courses.

Our Hiring Process

At Viridien, we are committed to delivering a respectful, inclusive, and transparent recruitment experience. Due to the high volume of applications we receive, we may not be able to provide individual feedback to every applicant. Only candidates whose qualifications closely match the role criteria will be contacted for an interview. We do, however, aim to share personalized feedback with those who progress to the first round of interviews and beyond. We are also dedicated to ensuring that our hiring process is accessible to all. If you require any reasonable adjustments to fully participate in the application or interview stages, please don’t hesitate to contact your recruiter directly. We see things differently. Diversity fuels our innovation; we value the unique ways in which we differ, and we are committed to equal employment opportunities for all professionals.

description:
The Talent Acquisition department hires qualified candidates to fill positions that contribute to the overall strategic success of Howard University. Hiring staff "for fit" makes significant contributions to Howard University’s overall mission. At Howard University, we prioritize well-being and professional growth.

Benefits

  • Work-Life Balance: PTO, paid holidays, flexible work arrangements
  • Financial Wellness: Competitive salary, 403(b) with company match
  • Professional Development: Ongoing training, tuition reimbursement, and career advancement paths
  • Additional Perks: Wellness programs, commuter benefits, and a vibrant company culture

For more information:

Responsibilities

Full-time laboratory research position in Alzheimer’s disease and related dementia (ADRD). Key responsibilities include conducting experiments utilizing various techniques specific to the laboratory to investigate mechanisms and treatment strategies of ADRD. Maintain detailed and accurate records of experimental procedures and results. Collect, maintain, analyze, and interpret experimental data using appropriate statistical and analytical methods. Contribute to the preparation of research presentations and manuscripts. Participate in lab meeting seminars and collaborative research discussions. Assist with general lab maintenance and organization, including ordering supplies and ensuring compliance with safety regulations.

Supervisory Authority

Host laboratory mentors and program leadership provide supervisory authority for HU-ERA-PREP Scholars. Fellows will report to assigned research mentors at host labs, who will provide direct oversight, mentorship and project management. Research supervisors will enforce compliance with institutional policies, ethical guidelines, and safety regulations. Regular performance evaluations will be conducted to provide constructive feedback, identify areas for improvement, and recognize exceptional performance and contributions.

Nature and Scope

Fellows will engage in advanced research focused on mechanisms underlying Alzheimer’s disease or related dementias, including preventive and treatment strategies. This position offers a unique opportunity for recent graduates to gain hands‑on research experience and contribute to high‑impact projects in a collaborative and supportive environment.

Principal Accountabilities

  • Work collaboratively with principal investigators, postdoctoral fellows and other research staff, including assisting in mentoring and training junior lab members.
  • Engage in continuous learning by staying current with relevant advances in the field. Attend workshops, seminars, and conferences to enhance skills and knowledge.
  • Seek feedback and opportunities for growth in research practices and methodologies.

Core Competencies

  • Previous research experience is preferred but not required.
  • Data analysis capabilities, proficiency in using analytical software.
  • Attention to detail and meticulous record‑keeping.
  • Willingness to learn new techniques and adapt to evolving research needs.
  • Effective written and verbal communication skills.
  • Ability to work collaboratively with diverse individuals and foster a cooperative lab environment.
  • Commitment to ethical research practices and adherence to institutional and regulatory guidelines.

Minimum Requirements

Bachelor’s degree in a related field (e.g., biology, neuroscience, psychology, biomedical sciences, biomedical engineering). Received a Bachelor’s degree within the past two years. Strong academic record with a 3.2 minimum GPA. Desire to pursue a research‑focused career in Alzheimer’s disease and related dementias. Prior biomedical research experience preferred but not required.

$20.11 per hour

MISSÃO

Desenvolver, supervisionar e garantir a eficácia dos padrões clínicos e das intervenções baseadas em Análise do Comportamento Aplicada (ABA) na Jano Saúde, promovendo a qualidade dos atendimentos, a formação da equipe clínica e a adesão às melhores práticas com base em evidências científicas. ATIVIDADES

  • Coletar e selecionar informações do histórico do indivíduo e da família, assim como dados de equipes multidisciplinares e escolas, para o delineamento da intervenção.
  • Esclarecer possíveis dúvidas que a família, escola ou equipe multidisciplinar possam ter sobre a intervenção.

Avaliação comportamental e desenvolvimento do plano de tratamento individualizado (PTI)

  • Planejar e realizar avaliação de repertório, desenvolvimento e qualidade de vida.
  • Planejar e realizar avaliações funcionais.
  • Redigir relatórios de avaliação e protocolos, programas ou procedimentos individualizados de ensino de habilidades, prevenção e redução de problemas de comportamento do aprendiz com base na função.
  • Realizar reavaliação de repertório a cada 4 meses.
  • Realizar reavaliação de repertório, desenvolvimento e qualidade de vida a cada 1 ano.
  • Definir carga horária e local de tratamento do cliente.

Intervenção

  • Confeccionar o plano de intervenção individualizado (PTI) do aprendiz.
  • Auxiliar no desenvolvimento de materiais instrucionais (programas e descrição de procedimentos) e folhas de registro necessárias para a implementação da intervenção.
  • Supervisionar no mínimo 10% da carga horária de intervenção, distribuídas em horas de supervisão diretas e indiretas.
  • Avaliar o progresso dos comportamentos na intervenção a partir da análise dos dados sistematizados e/ou observação direta (na presença e na ausência do aprendiz).
  • Realizar relatórios de evolução mensal para plano de saúde quando necessário.
  • Acompanhar os planos de transição entre equipes, desligamento ou alta do aprendiz.
  • Redigir documentos como pautas e atas de reuniões realizadas com familiares e equipe.
  • Modificar ou descontinuar do serviço prestado, baseado na avaliação dos riscos e benefícios de continuar a intervenção ou substituí-la por práticas alternativas, estando a decisão formalizada em prontuário/ficha de atendimento do aprendiz.

Coordenação, monitoramento e treinamento

  • Avaliar e prover feedback do desempenho da equipe de intervenção comportamental e familiares na implementação dos procedimentos delineados para o aprendiz.
  • Realizar orientação e treino parental.

ESCOLARIDADE / FORMAÇÃO

EXPERIÊNCIA PROFISSIONAL

  • Experiência anterior como supervisor ABA acima de 1 ano.

title: Chief Compliance Officer
description:
The Talent Acquisition department hires qualified candidates to fill positions which contribute to the overall strategic success of Howard University. Hiring staff “for fit” makes significant contributions to Howard University’s overall mission.

At Howard University, we prioritize well-being and professional growth.

Here Is What We Offer

  • Health & Wellness: Comprehensive medical, dental, and vision insurance, plus mental health support
  • Work-Life Balance: PTO, paid holidays, flexible work arrangements
  • Financial Wellness: Competitive salary, 403(b) with company match
  • Professional Development: Ongoing training, tuition reimbursement, and career advancement paths
  • Additional Perks: Wellness programs, commuter benefits, and a vibrant company culture

Basic Function

This position serves as the Chief Compliance Officer, overseeing the university’s compliance program, that promotes honesty, integrity and adherence to internal policies and external regulatory requirement. The Chief Compliance Officer requires extensive experience in Compliance to effectively promote a culture of integrity, advise leadership and navigate complex University operations.

The institutional Compliance Program reinforces the University’s commitment to meeting the highest standards of ethics, integrity, and responsibility, providing independent and objective oversight of the University's compliance program to ensure that the University is compliant with all federal, state, and local laws and regulations as well as University policies.

The Chief Compliance Officer will report directly to Howard University’s Office of President and to the Board of Trustees.

Supervisory Accountability

The Chief Compliance Officer will have direct supervisory oversight of the Compliance divisions across the enterprise to include Howard University, Howard University Health Sciences and Howard University Hospital.

Principal Accountabilities

  • Leads the enterprise-wide Compliance program in accordance with the 7 Elements of an Effective Compliance Program as promulgated by the Federal Sentencing Guidelines by promoting and managing the University's Code of Ethical Conduct, maintaining and managing the Howard University Compliance hotline and other reporting channels facilitating and overseeing campus compliance committees, advising on conflict of interest issues and leading compliance training efforts across the enterprise.
  • Serves as liaison to the Audit and Legal Committee of Howard University’s Board of Trustees, and reporting to the committee during scheduled or ad hoc meetings to keep the Board apprised of present and emerging audit and compliance issues.
  • Meets external parties on compliance topics as a representative of the University; participates in the President’s staff meetings as requested and, represents the compliance function in various standing and ad hoc University committees and departments, and meets frequently with various groups of key administrators and leaders across the enterprise to report and advise.
  • Responsible for all administrative and leadership functions for the Office of Audit and Compliance, including hiring, supervision, and other personnel decisions; managing the departmental budget and resources effectively and efficiently; maintaining a professional audit, compliance, and Title IX staff with sufficient knowledge, skills, experience, and professional certifications to meet the requirements of internal and external directives; and overseeing departmental strategic planning.

Core Competencies

  • A minimum of 10 years of professional audit experience in a leadership position(s) preferably in higher education and research.
  • Requires in-depth knowledge of regulatory frameworks relevant to academic and research institutions is necessary and a high degree of competency in investigative processes and an understanding and ability for collaborative engagement within the cross-functional University operations.
  • Active participation in professional organizations in a leadership role, speaking, writing articles, or active committee participation.
  • Experience in building, training, and developing strong audit teams of five or more professional staff.
  • Experience in operational/program analysis, quality improvement, and efficiency and effectiveness reviews is a plus. Experience with a large public university system and an understanding of a university environment and its unique characteristics.
  • Knowledge of the operation of a large university system, a four-year university campus including academic areas, athletics, auxiliary services, and student services, and/or an academic health care center. The ability to prepare comprehensive reports and presentations, utilizing excellent verbal and written communication skills, public speaking, and training skills as well as excellent analytical and problem-solving skills.
  • In-depth knowledge of current compliance practices, risk assessment, and investigative processes.
  • Skill in preparing or monitoring the preparation of comprehensive reports, interpreting and applying policies and regulations, and conducting interviews. The ability to present training and information on fraud prevention, effective controls, and best practices to faculty, staff, and management.
  • Supervisory skills including the ability to motivate professional staff at different locations across the state, including educating and promoting a culture of learning while serving as a mentor and advocate.
  • Ability to organize work and prioritize objectives; to evaluate evidence; to exercise independent judgment; to plan, implement, evaluate and report activities.
  • Skill in establishing and maintaining working relationships and managing and resolving conflicts with diverse constituencies across UT System.
  • Willingness to travel.
  • Ability to maintain confidentiality and objectivity. Soundness of judgment is necessary to lead the institutional compliance function. Ability to effectively interact with and communicate information to senior management and the Audit and Compliance Committee, including the ability to be transparent, open, and with a demonstrated commitment to the highest ethical and professional standards.
  • Ability to be nimble, flexible, and handle ambiguity well.
  • Ability to communicate and demonstrate interpersonal skills, with the ability to influence through personal credibility, integrity, and professionalism.
  • A commitment to affirmative action, equal employment opportunity, diversity, and inclusion.

Minimum Requirements

  • A Bachelor’s degree.
  • Compliance Certification is required (Certified Compliance & Ethics Professional (CCEP)).

Compliance Salary Range Disclosure

Compensation Range: $240,000 - $260,000

title: GIG- Operador de Equipamentos
description:
Descrição da vaga

Venha trabalhar em uma das maiores empresas especializadas em assistência à aviação no país! ✈️

A dnata Brasil opera em 30 aeroportos, garantindo que todos os voos recebam o melhor atendimento com o máximo de agilidade; nossas equipes são reconhecidas pela dedicação, profissionalismo, ética, qualidade e expertise apresentados; somos 100% dedicados ao cumprimento de nossas funções.

Globalmente, a dnata foi fundada em 1959 em Dubai, possui mais de 46.000 funcionários divididos em 38 países nos 6 continentes, com atuação em 136 aeroportos e auxiliando mais de 347 clientes.

O Operador de Equipamentos ficará responsável por realizar a operação de atendimento de rampa (movimentação de equipamentos motorizados ou não, embarque e desembarque de passageiros cadeirantes, transporte de bagagens e cargas entre as áreas operacionais do aeroporto) em aeronaves com segurança, qualidade e pontualidade, garantindo eficiência no processo e colaborando para a construção da percepção do cliente quanto aos serviços prestados pela empresa no que tange ao transporte de bagagens, cargas e pontualidade dos voos.

Esta é uma vaga exclusiva para o Aeroporto do Galeão (GIG) !

Responsabilidades e atribuições

  • Operar os equipamentos de rampa, realizando a movimentação segura de equipamentos rebocáveis no que tange a logística de preparação de box para atendimento dos voos com equipamentos necessários de acordo com a disponibilidade, levando-se em consideração o load fator, turnaroud da aeronave, distribuição de cargas e bagagens nos porões;
  • Disponibilizar os equipamentos de GPU, ACU e LPU sempre que a aeronave estiver com APU inoperante e/ou para a execução do projeto smart fuel;
  • Realizar o transporte de bagagem e cargas entre variadas áreas de cada aeroporto que estão embarcando, desembarcando ou em conexão;
  • Garantir a segurança de todos durante o atendimento operacional;
  • Garantir a transferência das bagagens de conexão imediata (HOT), para as outas aeronaves;
  • Recolher os equipamentos do box após o termino do atendimento.

Requisitos e qualificações

  • Carteira Nacional de Habilitação (CNH) tipo D/E.
  • Visão analítica e sistemática, para tomadas de decisões;
  • Disponibilidade de horário;
  • Conhecimento em processo de atendimento ao cliente;

Nos aspectos físicos exigem-se coordenação motora ampla e fina, destreza, articulação dos membros superiores e dos inferiores, postura variável para desenvolvimento de suas atividades, rotação e flexão do tronco e esforço físico, locomoção e deambulação para desenvolvimento das tarefas.

Nos aspectos sensoriais exigem-se acuidade visual para condução dos veículos (atividade regulamentada pelo CTB – código de trânsito brasileiro) e percepção auditiva para detecção de sinais sonoros emergenciais.

Nos aspectos neuropsíquicos exigem-se atenção, concentração, habilidade organizacional, criatividade, interpretação de dados e iniciativa para solução de situações causais.

Informações adicionais

Estamos sempre em busca de novos talentos, então faça o seu cadastro e venha fazer parte do time dnata Brasil!

dnata Brasil — faça parte do futuro da aviação. ✈️

É quase impossível você andar em um aeroporto no Brasil e não ver o logotipo da dnata . Somos um dos maiores hubs da dnata no mundo, atuando em 26 aeroportos , de norte a sul do país, e em mais de 140 aeroportos em todo o planeta. Sempre em terra, garantindo que cada atendimento aconteça com segurança, responsabilidade e excelência .

Aqui, você fará parte de um time com mais de 6.000 profissionais da aviação , especialistas em assistência em solo , atuando desde o atendimento ao passageiro , passando pelo manuseio de bagagens, operações de rampa e chegando até o pushback da aeronave , para a aviação comercial e executiva.

Atendemos mais de 20 companhias aéreas e realizamos mais de 250 mil turnarounds por ano . ✨

title: Postbaccalaureate Research Fellow
description:
The Talent Acquisition department hires qualified candidates to fill positions which contribute to the overall strategic success of Howard University. Hiring staff “for fit” makes significant contributions to Howard University’s overall mission.

At Howard University, we prioritize well‑being and professional growth.

Here Is What We Offer

  • Health & Wellness: Comprehensive medical, dental, and vision insurance, plus mental health support
  • Work-Life Balance: PTO, paid holidays, flexible work arrangements
  • Financial Wellness: Competitive salary, 403(b) with company match
  • Professional Development: Ongoing training, tuition reimbursement, and career advancement paths
  • Additional Perks: Wellness programs, commuter benefits, and a vibrant company culture

Join Howard University and thrive with us!

Basic Function

Full‑time laboratory research position in Alzheimer’s disease and related dementia (ADRD). Key responsibilities include:

  • Conduct experiments utilizing various techniques specific to the laboratory to investigate mechanisms and treatment strategies of ADRD. Maintain detailed and accurate records of experimental procedures and results.
  • Collect, maintain, analyze, and interpret experimental data using appropriate statistical and analytical methods. Contribute to the preparation of research presentations and manuscripts. Participate in lab meeting seminars, and collaborative research discussions.
  • Assist with general lab maintenance and organization, including ordering supplies and ensuring compliance with safety regulations.

Supervisory Authority

Host laboratory mentors and program leadership provide supervisory authority for HU-ERA-PREP Scholars. Fellows will report to assigned research mentors at host labs, who will provide direct oversight, mentorship, and project management including ensuring accurate documentation and presentation of research activities and findings. Research supervisors will enforce compliance with institutional policies, ethical guidelines, and safety regulations. Regular performance evaluations will be conducted to provide constructive feedback, identify areas for improvement, and recognize exceptional performance and contributions.

Nature And Scope

Fellows will engage in advanced research focused on mechanisms underlying Alzheimer’s disease or related dementias including preventative and treatment strategies. This position offers a unique opportunity for recent graduates to gain hands‑on research experience and contribute to high‑impact projects in a collaborative and supportive environment.

Principal Accountabilities
