Descrição da vaga

Inquietos e Acelerados. Criativos ou Cartesianos. Talentosos e Autodidatas. Artesanais ou Tecnológicos. Não importa: gostamos de diversidade e de quem está aqui para agregar.

Porque GENTE É O QUE SOMA.

Buscamos uma Pessoa Desenvolvedora Mobile Flutter Sênior para atuar em um ecossistema de aplicativos digitais iOS e Android, com múltiplos produtos, marcas e integrações, garantindo qualidade técnica, performance e experiência consistente para o usuário final.

Você precisa ser uma pessoa apaixonada por tecnologia, com forte perfil analítico, colaborativo e orientado a aprendizado contínuo, capaz de atuar em arquitetura, sustentação e evolução de apps em produção em um ambiente ágil.

QUER FAZER PARTE DESTA JORNADA COM A GENTE?

Responsabilidades e atribuições

  • Desenvolver e evoluir aplicativos móveis em Flutter (Dart) para Android e iOS, desde a concepção até a publicação e manutenção, utilizando boas práticas de arquitetura em camadas, Clean Architecture e princípios SOLID.
  • Implementar telas, fluxos e componentes com atenção a UX, performance e estabilidade, incluindo composição de UIs complexas e widgets customizados.
  • Integrar os apps com APIs REST e serviços de terceiros, garantindo autenticação, tratamento robusto de erros e boa experiência em cenários offline/intermitentes.
  • Atuar na sustentação dos aplicativos: correção de bugs, investigação com logs e Crashlytics, análise de performance e prevenção de regressões.
  • Escrever e manter testes automatizados (unitários e de widgets), garantindo cobertura mínima em fluxos críticos de negócio e UI.
  • Participar de code reviews, refinamentos, estimativas e cerimônias ágeis (Scrum/Kanban), contribuindo para decisões técnicas e de produto.
  • Colaborar com times de back-end, produto e design na definição de contratos de API, integrações, Design System e experiências consistentes entre plataformas.
  • Apoiar e evoluir a observabilidade dos apps (Crashlytics, Analytics, Feature Flags, Remote Config) e a experimentação via testes A/B.
  • Contribuir com documentação técnica, boas práticas de desenvolvimento e, quando necessário, participação em etapas técnicas de seleção (entrevistas e avaliações).

Requisitos e qualificações

REQUISITOS OBRIGATÓRIOS:

  • Experiência sólida com Flutter e Dart em produção, incluindo publicação e manutenção de apps em Android e iOS.
  • Forte domínio de recursos modernos da linguagem Dart e programação assíncrona (Futures, Streams, async/await).
  • Experiência prática com arquitetura em camadas, Clean separação de responsabilidades e gerenciamento de estado com GetX (lifecycle, .obs, Obx, GetBuilder).
  • Vivência com testes unitários e testes de widgets em Flutter, aplicados a lógica de negócio e componentes de UI.
  • Experiência consumindo APIs REST e integrando com serviços externos, incluindo tratamento de erros e lógica de autenticação.
  • Conhecimento de Git (Bitbucket ou equivalentes), fluxos de pull request e práticas de code review.
  • Vivência com ferramentas da Firebase Suite: Crashlytics, Analytics, Performance, Remote Config e Cloud Messaging.
  • Experiência com CI/CD para mobile/Flutter (ex.: CodeMagic, pipelines de integração e entrega contínua).
  • Noções sólidas de qualidade de código: organização, tratamento de erros, logging estruturado e atenção à performance.
  • +5 anos de experiência prática com Flutter/Dart

DIFERENCIAIS:

  • Experiência com múltiplas marcas / white-label apps, mantendo configurações distintas em um ecossistema compartilhado de packages.
  • Vivência com packages interconectados, modularização e gestão de dependências locais (path-based dependencies) e overrides.
  • Implementação de Design System proprietário, componentes reutilizáveis, tematização e animações com Lottie.
  • Experiência com Analytics (AppsFlyer, Firebase Analytics, Insider) e Deep Linking (App Links, Universal Links, URL schemes).
  • Experiência com WebViews (InAppWebView customizada, WebView Flutter) e Push Notifications (Firebase Messaging, Flutter Local Notifications).

description:
The Talent Acquisition department hires qualified candidates to fill positions which contribute to the overall strategic success of Howard University. Hiring staff “for fit” makes significant contributions to Howard University’s overall mission.

At Howard University, we prioritize well-being and professional growth.

Here Is What We Offer

  • Health & Wellness: Comprehensive medical, dental, and vision insurance, plus mental health support
  • Work-Life Balance: PTO, paid holidays, flexible work arrangements
  • Financial Wellness: Competitive salary, 403(b) with company match
  • Professional Development: Ongoing training, tuition reimbursement, and career advancement paths
  • Additional Perks: Wellness programs, commuter benefits, and a vibrant company culture

Join Howard University and thrive with us!

Basic Function

The Assistant Registrar for Records and Registration is responsible for the interpretation and application of student records policies, grade processing, registration functions and the overall accuracy and integrity for the production and maintenance of academic records for all students.

This position will serve as a primary contact point for student records inquiries, transfer credit evaluation and processing, enrollment, and registration. With an emphasis on service, efficiency, and use of technology, the Assistant Registrar will assist in streamlining overall processes and services for the records and transfer credit functions of the Office of the Registrar.

Supervisory Authority

Responsible for providing supervision for various functions and work units. Formally plans, assigns, directs, and coordinates the work of these functions. Performs staff evaluations and makes recommendations regarding pay and/or performance.

Nature And Scope

Internal contacts include administrators, faculty, staff and students. External contacts include vendors, contractors, visitors, alumni and the general public.

Principal Accountabilities

  • Assists in the operational functions related to enrollment & registration including, but not limited to, registration permissions, overrides, waitlist and batch registration.
  • Collects, records, maintains, and reports academic records in accordance with FERPA and university best practices (i.e., enrollment data, athletic eligibility, and completion data).
  • Manages transfer credit evaluation and processing using AACRAO transfer credit best practices.
  • Manages progress toward degree completion requirements and compliance for student athletes in accordance with NCAA, MEAC and University rules.
  • Produces academic standing and Deans list reports for review by the Provost’s Office and various schools and colleges.
  • Oversees grade reporting process (i.e., requests, changes of grades, and incomplete grades).
  • Supervises organization of archived records and transcripts.
  • Supervises and ensures accurate reporting of enrollment/degree verification processing for student insurance needs, student loan deferment documents and National Student Clearinghouse requests.
  • Troubleshoots and resolves problems with student records activities.
  • Develops and delivers point-of-use training to faculty and academic unit staff.
  • Supervises the management of Office of the Registrar email account

Core Competencies

  • Experience with complex student information systems, course registration, curriculum and enrollment planning software (i.e. Banner, Colleague, Workday).
  • Experience in understanding administrative registration matters across higher education.
  • Strong understanding of best practices in student registration and records and understands the role of the Registrar in strategic enrollment management and student success.
  • Ability to analyze and interpret academic records and make independent decisions and judgments in accordance with Howard University policy.
  • Ability to manage and adhere to tight deadlines and handle multiple tasks simultaneously.
  • Ability to set a high standard of professionalism by providing high quality customer services to the general public, students, faculty and staff.
  • Detail-oriented and customer service and compliance-focused.
  • Proven record of accountability and follow-through.
  • Ability to effectively communicate with a wide range of individuals and constituencies in a diverse community.
  • Strong knowledge of all standard computer applications, including Microsoft Office products, with advanced level skills in Microsoft Excel as it applies to data management

Minimum Requirements

Bachelor’s degree required; Master’s degree preferred. Minimum of 3 years of managerial experience in a registrar’s office or closely related enrollment. Management professional at a higher education institution.

Compliance Salary Range Disclosure

Expected Salary Range: $65,000 - $75,000

title: Executive Chef
description:
Descrição da empresa

Emerging as a pioneering French luxury hospitality brand in 1964, Sofitel brings French zest and inspires heartfelt encounters to the most sought-after destinations worldwide. Seamlessly melding local culture with the French zest for life through remarkable savoir-faire and generous service, Sofitel is for free-minded travelers and arts and culture aficionados who have an appreciation for a refined and understated sense of modern luxury.

THE HOTEL

Sofitel, a global reference in French luxury hospitality, announces the transformation of Sofitel Rio de Janeiro Ipanema into its first flagship hotel in Brazil, with an expected opening by the end of 2026. Located on Ipanema Beach, the hotel will feature 172 rooms and embody the brand’s contemporary vision of luxury, experience, and service excellence.

Join the team of talents who will bring this new icon of luxury hospitality in Brazil to life.

Descrição da vaga

We are seeking an accomplished Executive Chef to lead our culinary operations, crafting exceptional dining experiences across 7 outlets. This is a unique opportunity to shape the gastronomic vision of a landmark property, managing a high-performing team and delivering world-class cuisine in a dynamic luxury environment.

Key Roles & Responsibilities

  • Lead all culinary operations from pre-opening through ongoing hotel operations, establishing the kitchen’s structure, standards, and workflows;
  • Design and refine innovative menus and recipes, ensuring alignment with brand standards and guest expectations;
  • Train and mentor the kitchen team, nurturing their growth and passion while upholding the brand’s signature standards of refinement and innovation;
  • Oversee daily kitchen operations, ensuring efficiency, consistency, and culinary excellence;
  • Implement and enforce rigorous food safety, hygiene, and sanitation standards, fully compliant with HACCP and local regulations;
  • Maintain quality control processes to ensure food freshness, consistency, presentation, and adherence to hygiene standards;
  • Manage food inventory, control costs, approve purchase orders, and operate within the established budget;
  • Conduct regular performance appraisals, provide constructive feedback, and support ongoing professional development of the team;
  • Develop and maintain departmental operations manuals and training programs to ensure consistent standards, compliance, and continuous improvement;
  • Monitor guest feedback, adapting offerings and service to uphold Sofitel’s luxury culinary experience.

Qualificações

  • Bachelor’s degree in Culinary with advanced certifications;
  • 10+ years leading high-end kitchens in luxury hotels or fine dining establishments, with proven experience managing large, talented teams;
  • Mastery of international and French cuisine, menu innovation, and flawless food presentation;
  • Expertise in cost control, budgeting, inventory management, and operational efficiency;
  • Deep knowledge of food safety, sanitation, and compliance standards;
  • Exceptional leadership, mentoring, and team-building skills; thrives under pressure in fast-paced luxury environments;
  • Passion for creating unforgettable dining experiences with the highest standards of quality, creativity, and innovation;
  • Commitment to cultivating a positive kitchen culture and introducing signature and seasonal concepts that define the hotel’s culinary identity;
  • Fluent in Portuguese, English and French with excellent communication skills.

SOBRE A VAGA

Para isso, contamos com um time de profissionais inquietos, com brilho nos olhos e movidos por entusiasmo. Procuramos um(a) Professor(a) de Português (Produção Textual) para o Fundamental 2. Deve ser uma pessoa com paixão por educação e pelo universo dinâmico da escola, que tenha experiência em escola regular ou bilíngue com planejamento e execução de aulas dessa disciplina.

RESPONSABILIDADES

O que você fará:

  • Adquirir conhecimento sobre os programas curriculares utilizados nas séries em que leciona;
  • Trabalhar colaborativamente com outros professores e lideranças da matéria e do segmento, buscando alinhamento e consistência;

  • Garantir a segurança física e emocional dos alunos, e zelar pelo seu crescimento sócio-emocional (safeguarding).

Por mais que nos esforcemos para incluir todas as principais responsabilidades e atribuições desta posição, pode ser que nem toda atividade pertinente à função tenha sido identificada. Dessa forma, a lista acima não é restritiva e pode ser estendida ou alterada para incluir outras tarefas que se aplicam ao cargo.

  • Estar sempre em busca de melhorias;
  • Atitude positiva frente a mudanças;
  • Compreensão profunda da matéria lecionada;
  • Estabelecer expectativas claras e esticar metas;
  • Excelente planejamento de aulas e domínio de sala;
  • Habilidade de julgar a efetividade do aprendizado;
  • Comprometimento com o desenvolvimento dos alunos, avaliando os resultados e fornecendo feedback para melhorar seu desempenho;

DECLARAÇÃO DE SALVAGUARDA

O Inspired se compromete em salvaguardar e promover o bem-estar das crianças e jovens e, se você se juntar ao nosso time, esperaremos o mesmo de você, assim como que se comprometa a realizar os treinamentos de safeguarding que consideramos pertinentes à sua função. title: Project Manager
description:
Intermoor, Acteon's Moorings and Anchors business line, provides project and operational management expertise to customers across the mooring lifecycle. By combining operational knowledge of mooring equipment, anchor handling and industry failure modes with subsea engineering expertise, we create a company unmatched within the mooring niche. This approach mitigates risks in delivery, installation and operations across the lifecycle, reducing mooring lifecycle costs and safeguarding major operations that protect start-up schedules when mooring and mooring intervention are on the project or production critical path.

InterMoor is looking to add a Project Manager to the team. The Project Manager's primary responsibility is to plan, direct, and coordinate activities of a single or multiple projects to ensure that goals or objectives of project are safely accomplished within prescribed time frame and funding parameters and the customer receives a quality product or service which meets or exceeds all of the customer requirements.

The successful candidate will be based in the Rio de Janeiro area.

Please submit Resumes/CVs in English.

Duties

  • Plan, direct and coordinate the activities of one or more projects, ensuring that the objectives are achieved safely, within the established deadlines and budget limits
  • Structure and monitor project budgets, providing revenue and cost analysis, including the appropriate credit releases, as well as participate in the revenue and cost forecast process
  • Develop and maintain the project schedule with resource allocation, including detailed work breakdown structure (WBS)
  • Manage projects and assigned teams on a daily basis, including planning operations and supervising operational personnel in the field, reviewing procedures, staffing needs, and resource allocation in all phases of the project, ensuring compliance with schedule and budget
  • Act in the daily monitoring of projects and systems to identify deviations and ensure that activities occur as planned
  • Propose and implement solutions to mitigate operational downtime or delays that impact the customer or the profitability of the project
  • Support customers in the elaboration of design concepts and technical specifications
  • Conduct presentations and support commercial activities
  • When applicable, coordinate with the Operations and Commercial areas the development of proposals and bids
  • Review and approve quality plans and technical procedures, as well as develop procedures for subsea projects, when necessary
  • Analyze proposals and project plans to define deadlines, budget limits, procedures, staffing needs, and resource allocation by phase
  • Define the work plan and the sizing of teams for each phase of the project, informing the personnel needs to the Operations area
  • Align work plans with project teams, assigning responsibilities, scope, and levels of authority
  • Direct and coordinate project activities to ensure execution on time and within the approved budget
  • Review status reports and adjust timelines or plans as needed
  • Oversee the issuance of requisitions that are not related to general maintenance and repairs, as well as review and approve supplier invoices
  • Prepare project reports, forecasts, variance analysis and other technical and financial reports for management, customers or other stakeholders
  • Together with Technical Support, provide support to project teams, offering technical guidance and support in solving problems
  • Review and approve project invoices and support the financial area in matters related to accounts receivable with customers
  • Carry out national and international trips, as needed
  • Maintain mandatory training according to management guidelines
  • Work in close collaboration with the Commercial Department in the analysis of ITTs and submission of proposals, ensuring a well-defined scope, technical skills, necessary equipment and full understanding of terms, conditions and pricing
  • In coordination with the Commercial area, make presentations to customers about new technologies or solutions that improve their performance
  • Implement QHSE Management Systems and ensure compliance with local regulations
  • Verify the compliance of the systems with all Technical, Operational and QHSE bulletins
  • Prepare project reports, forecasts, variance analysis and other technical or financial reports as required by management, customers or other stakeholders

Required

  • Complete higher education in Engineering, preferably Naval Engineering
  • Active CREA registration
  • Desirable post-graduation in a related area
  • Fluent in English (spoken and written)
  • Desirable good knowledge in Autocad, Office package, AutoCAD®, SolidWorks, Orcaflex
  • Desirable experience of at least 8 years in the design and/or installation of permanent anchoring systems for units such as FPSOs, FSOs, FSUs or CALM buoys, among others
  • Experience in developing offshore operating procedures for subsea installation and/or construction
  • Good vision and business understanding
  • Experience in installing flexible and umbilical risers
  • Expertise in installation analysis
  • Experience using OrcaFlex software
  • Experience in developing tenders, including methodologies, schedules, and financial estimates/calculations
  • Experience in team leadership and team member guidance

title: Implementations Accountant
description:
Carta is a platform that helps people manage equity, build businesses, and invest in the companies of tomorrow. Our mission is to unlock the power of equity ownership for more people in more places.

Carta is trusted by more than 40,000 companies and over two million people in nearly 160 countries to manage cap tables, compensation, and valuations. Carta also supports nearly 7,000 funds and SPVs, and represents nearly $130B in assets under administration. Carta’s tender offer solutions have returned $14B to shareholders in secondary transactions. Today, Carta’s platform manages nearly three trillion dollars in equity globally.

Problems You’ll Solve

  • Collaborate with new fund clients to collect data and advise on best accounting practices within Service Level Agreements (SLAs)
  • Effectively liaise between sales and Fund Accounting teams as the bridge post‑sales
  • Identify process and quality improvements and highlight them to appropriate leadership
  • Create balanced, accurate quarterly financial statements from, at times, unstructured client data

The Team You'll Work With

As an Implementations Accountant, you will join a team that supports new Fund Administration customers in their journey into Carta services. You will drive operational excellence within our fast‑growing Fund Administration business by coordinating, facilitating, and managing onboarding activities that are critical to achieving success for both our customers and Carta within a tight deadline.

In this role you will be responsible for interacting with a fund’s back office (CFO fund manager) to collect their historical data, provide advisory support, and ultimately deliver accurate financial statements to both the client and internal stakeholders.

From sale close, to implementation, and continued customer success, the ideal Implementations Accountant will exhibit a high degree of problem‑solving, efficiency, and integrity as they leverage their subject‑matter expertise to provide customers with a world‑class onboarding experience.

About You

  • Bachelor’s degree in Accounting, Finance, or related field, or equivalent experience
  • 1+ years of experience in a role with a finance or accounting background
  • Strong accounting analysis with the ability to interpret a story through unstructured data
  • Committed to team and project success, emotionally intelligent in navigating relationships, transparent and forthright when communicating information, and passionate about growing and advancing with Carta
  • Proven internal influencer having implemented and successfully managed both small and large projects or initiatives with sustained, measurable success
  • Incredible organizational skills, high attention to detail, and an ability to complete competing priorities quickly and autonomously
  • Ability to communicate in both written and verbal formats in a timely and appropriate manner
  • Fluent in English, both written and verbal

Nice‑to‑Haves

  • Acumen in or knowledge of accounting with a specific focus in venture, hedge fund, and/or private equity
  • Familiarity as an end user with Carta or other financial dataset or accounting software programs

Compensation

Carta’s compensation package includes a market competitive salary, equity for all full time roles, exceptional benefits, and, for applicable roles, commissions plans. Our expected cash compensation range for this role is:

  • $81,000 - $85,000 in New York, New York
  • $81,000 - $85,000 in San Francisco, California
  • $72,900 - $76,500 in Seattle, Washington

title: Manager, West Campus Facilities
description:
The Talent Acquisition department hires qualified candidates to fill positions which contribute to the overall strategic success of Howard University. Hiring staff “for fit” makes significant contributions to Howard University’s overall mission.

At Howard University, we prioritize well-being and professional growth.

Here Is What We Offer

  • Health & Wellness: Comprehensive medical, dental, and vision insurance, plus mental health support
  • Work-Life Balance: PTO, paid holidays, flexible work arrangements
  • Financial Wellness: Competitive salary, 403(b) with company match
  • Professional Development: Ongoing training, tuition reimbursement, and career advancement paths
  • Additional Perks: Wellness programs, commuter benefits, and a vibrant company culture

Join Howard University and thrive with us!

Job Purpose

The West Campus Facilities Manager provides senior-level leadership and operational management for all facilities, maintenance, custodial coordination, and infrastructure operations across Howard University’s West Campus. This position serves as the primary facilities authority for the campus, ensuring that buildings, utilities, and grounds remain safe, reliable, and fully operational. The Manager oversees maintenance teams, custodial partners, and contractors while ensuring full compliance with engineering standards, APPA benchmarks, regulatory requirements, and University service expectations. The role carries significant operational responsibility and autonomy due to the size, complexity, and visibility of West Campus.

Supervisory Authority

Supervises maintenance technicians, trades personnel, custodial leads, administrative support, and contracted service providers assigned to West Campus. Oversees external vendors performing preventive maintenance, building repairs, custodial operations, inspections, and other facilities-related services.

Nature And Scope

Internal contacts include faculty, staff, students, Residence Life, Public Safety, academic departments, and administrative units. External contacts include contractors, vendors, utility partners, regulatory inspectors, custodial firms, and maintenance service providers. The Manager serves as the face of PFM for all West Campus facilities matters.

Principal Accountabilities

Campus Operations & Building Systems Oversight

  • Leads daily facilities operations for West Campus to ensure uninterrupted, high-quality building performance.
  • Manages preventive, corrective, and predictive maintenance across HVAC, mechanical, electrical, plumbing, and life-safety systems.
  • Conducts regular facility inspections to identify deficiencies, risks, code issues, and asset renewal needs.
  • Ensures timely work order management, documentation accuracy, and performance tracking through the CMMS.
  • Ensures coordination with capital projects and handoff from construction to operations.

Custodial Management & Service Quality

  • Coordinates custodial scheduling, assignments, and service quality aligned with APPA Level 2 standards.
  • Evaluates custodial contractor performance and directs corrective actions when service gaps arise.

Vendor, Contract, and Compliance Oversight

  • Oversees on-site performance of vendors supporting maintenance, custodial, utilities, and technical service operations.
  • Ensures full compliance with OSHA, EPA, NFPA, fire/life safety codes, and environmental health requirements.
  • Supports audits, inspections, and regulatory documentation.

Asset Management & Preventive Maintenance

  • Implements preventive maintenance programs to optimize asset life, system reliability, and operational efficiency.
  • Works closely with the Deputy Director and QA/QC Manager on engineering standards and continuous improvement initiatives.
  • Recommends capital renewal and lifecycle replacement priorities for campus infrastructure.

Stakeholder Relations & Customer Service

  • Acts as the primary point of contact for West Campus stakeholders.
  • Communicates maintenance activities, project impacts, and operational issues clearly and professionally.
  • Supports high-demand operational needs such as special events, move-ins/outs, and seasonal transitions.

Emergency Response & Safety Leadership

  • Leads operational response during outages, building emergencies, and severe weather events.
  • Ensures appropriate use of PPE, safe work practices, and hazard mitigation strategies.
  • Supports continuity-of-operations planning for critical campus systems.

Other Duties

  • Provides input on staffing needs, training, workflows, and operational efficiencies.
  • Supports deferred maintenance efforts and campus improvement initiatives.
  • Performs other related duties as assigned.

Core Competencies

  • Expert knowledge of building operations, maintenance, and custodial service standards.
  • Strong leadership and team management skills.
  • Excellent communication and customer service skills.
  • Solid problem-solving and analytical capabilities.
  • Ability to manage competing priorities in a fast-paced environment.
  • Commitment to operational excellence, safety, and continuous improvement.

Minimum Requirements

Bachelor’s degree preferred; associate degree with extensive experience considered. At least 7 years of progressive experience in facilities operations, building maintenance, or engineering services. Supervisory experience overseeing teams or contractors. Strong technical knowledge of HVAC, electrical, plumbing, and building systems. Proficiency with CMMS systems and work order management. OSHA, CEFP, or trade certifications preferred. Ability to respond to emergencies, work evenings/weekends, and support critical campus needs.

Compliance Salary Range Disclosure
$110,000 - $115,000

description:
Overview

At SITA, we keep airports moving, airlines flying smoothly, and borders open. Our technology and communication innovations power the success of the global air travel industry. You’ll find us in 95% of international airports, working closely with over 2,500 transportation and government clients. Each partnership brings unique challenges, and we thrive on delivering fresh solutions and cutting-edge tech to keep operations running like clockwork. Here, we feel empowered, supported, and inspired to grow.

Are you ready to love your job? The adventure begins right here, with you, at SITA.

About The Role & Team

Lead Life Cycle Engineer is Responsible for service provisioning and the end-to-end lifecycle of network security, shared infrastructure, SD-WAN, and other cloud security solutions.

What You Will Do

  • Manage the end-to-end lifecycle of network services (LAN wired/wireless, WAN, SD-WAN, network security, and shared infrastructure) from provisioning to decommissioning at airports and gateways.
  • Lead implementation and deployment of airport network and security infrastructure, including LAN, WAN, firewalls, and Versa SD-WAN solutions.
  • Provide expert-level support for complex network and security incidents when required.
  • Collaborate with cross-functional teams, including GEOs, to validate design documents, implement, and optimize network services aligned with business and customer needs.
  • Oversee service provisioning to ensure timely, accurate delivery and adherence to quality and operational standards.
  • Non-intrusive resiliency testing, timely audit security and configuration parameters aligned with engineering guidelines, drive proactive continuous service improvements.
  • Manage changes and enhancements to network and security services, mitigating risks and minimizing operational disruption.
  • Drive migration management activities, including root cause analysis and service improvement initiatives.
  • Evaluate and adopt new technologies, provide guidance and training to operational teams, and support 24/7 operations and on-call activities as required.

Qualifications

  • Bachelor’s degree in computer science, Information Technology, Network Engineering, or a related field.
  • Mandatory Security Associate–level certification and Professional-level SD-WAN certification.
  • Relevant industry certifications such as CCNP, CompTIA Network+, or equivalent are highly desirable.
  • 8–10 years of proven experience managing the end-to-end lifecycle of network services, including provisioning, monitoring, optimization, and decommissioning.
  • Strong knowledge of network service lifecycle management, service models, SLAs, and network management tools.
  • Hands-on experience in network service design, implementation, troubleshooting, and performance optimization.

description:
About Agoda

At Agoda, we bridge the world through travel. Our story began in 2005, when two lifelong friends and entrepreneurs, driven by their passion for travel, launched Agoda to make it easier for everyone to explore the world.

Today, we are part of Booking Holdings (NASDAQ: BKNG), with a diverse team of over 7,000 people from 90 countries, working together in offices around the globe. Every day, we connect people to destinations and experiences, with our great deals across our millions of hotels and holiday properties, flights, and experiences worldwide.

No two days are the same at Agoda. Data and technology are at the heart of our culture, fueling our curiosity and innovation. If you’re ready to begin your best journey and help build travel for the world, join us.

About The Role

We’re looking for an AI Conversational Designer to shape the behavior, flow, and quality of Agoda’s Chatbot assistant. This role owns how our Chatbot operates in multi-turn conversations: how they gather and use context, structure dialog, manage pacing and depth, and maintain a consistent voice across end-to-end journeys. It sits at the intersection of conversation design, UX, and content strategy, with a strong focus on AI-driven interactions. This is not a traditional content writing role. It’s a specialist position focused on designing scalable, high-quality conversational experiences for AI products.

What You’ll Do

Conversational experience:

  • Design and evolve conversational flows across user travel intents.
  • Define how the assistant gathers context through dialog, including sequencing, branching, and trade-offs.
  • Establish principles for conversational depth, pacing, and progression.
  • Own conversational experimentation, including defining hypotheses, running tests, and iterating based on user behavior and outcomes.

Tone and behavior:

  • Define and maintain the assistant’s tone of voice and behavioral principles in line with Agoda’s brand.
  • Ensure conversational consistency as new features, journeys, and surfaces are added.

AI and experimentation:

  • Guide LLM behavior through conversational patterns, examples, guardrails, and prompt optimization.
  • Design and run conversational experiments, including A/B testing, to validate approaches and improve outcomes.
  • Use data and qualitative feedback to iterate on conversational quality and effectiveness.

Collaboration:

  • Work closely with Product Managers, Designs, Content teams, Branding, and Engineering to align conversational intent with technical capabilities.
  • Act as a specialist partner, helping teams reason through conversational UX decisions rather than just producing outputs.

Enablement:

  • Create lightweight artifacts such as conversation flows, pattern libraries, and example dialogs.
  • Enable other designers to apply conversational patterns without creating long-term dependency.

What We’re Looking For

Required:

  • Experience in conversation design, or interaction design
  • Experience in prompt engineering and optimization
  • Demonstrated ability to design multi-turn, goal-oriented conversational experiences
  • Strong systems thinking and comfort working with ambiguity
  • Experience collaborating with UX designers, product managers and engineers
  • Experience working on chatbots, assistants, or AI-driven products

Nice to have:

  • Experience defining tone of voice or behavioral principles at scale
  • Background in service design or journey design

Why join us

  • Work on a high-impact product used by travelers globally
  • Shape conversational behavior at a platform level, not just feature by feature
  • Collaborate with experienced Product, Design, and Engineering teams
  • Opportunity to influence how conversational UX is practiced and scaled at Agoda

title: Postdoctoral Research Fellow
description:
Overview

The Talent Acquisition department hires qualified candidates to fill positions which contribute to the overall strategic success of Howard University. Hiring staff “for fit” makes significant contributions to Howard University’s overall mission. At Howard University, we prioritize well-being and professional growth.

Benefits

  • Health & Wellness: Comprehensive medical, dental, and vision insurance, plus mental health support
  • Work-Life Balance: PTO, paid holidays, flexible work arrangements
  • Financial Wellness: Competitive salary, 403(b) with company match
  • Professional Development: Ongoing training, tuition reimbursement, and career advancement paths
  • Additional Perks: Wellness programs, commuter benefits, and a vibrant company culture

Join Howard University and thrive with us!

Job Purpose

Conduct NIH-funded research on RNA-based gene regulation in Staphylococcus aureus, a gram-positive bacterial pathogen prone to cause multi-drug-resistant bloodstream infections. The specific focus will be on small proteins, small RNAs, and tRNA modifications. The postdoctoral research fellow will lead experiments investigating RNA–RNA and RNA–protein interactions in bacterial stress adaptation and virulence.

Supervisory Authority

Dr. Karl M. Thompson, Ph.D. – Associate Professor and University Biosafety Officer

Nature And Scope

This is a lab-based research position in molecular microbiology. The Fellow will:

  • Perform functional studies of small protein and RNA function and interactions using and combination of molecular genetics (mutants, over-expression, gene-fusions, two-hybrid constructs); biochemical and biophysical tools (e.g., AUC, MST, SEC-MALS).
  • Conduct RNA stability assays, RIP-seq, and bacterial genetics.
  • Collaborate on in vivo studies and murine infection models.
  • Contribute to mentoring, manuscript writing, and data presentation.

Principal Accountabilities

  • Design and execute experiments on RNA regulators and stress-response pathways.
  • Analyze and interpret data from RNA-protein and RNA-RNA interaction assays.
  • Generate and characterize mutant bacterial strains.
  • Maintain detailed lab records and uphold research rigor.
  • Support manuscript and grant preparation.

Core Competencies

  • Strong background in molecular microbiology and RNA biology.
  • Experience with RNA-binding assays, RIP/qPCR/seq, and transcript stability analysis.
  • Familiarity with protein–RNA interaction techniques and bacterial genetics.
  • Strong analytical and communication skills.

Minimum Requirements

  • PhD in Microbiology, Biochemistry, or related field.
  • Track record in RNA biology or microbial gene regulation.
  • Hands-on experience with relevant molecular techniques.
  • Prior S. aureus or Gram-positive pathogen work preferred

$50,000-$60,000

  • Minimum 7 years of experience from similar position

title: Research Assistant-1
description:
The Talent Acquisition department hires qualified candidates to fill positions which contribute to the overall strategic success of Howard University. Hiring staff “for fit” makes significant contributions to Howard University’s overall mission. At Howard University, we prioritize well-being and professional growth.

Here Is What We Offer

  • Health & Wellness: Comprehensive medical, dental, and vision insurance, plus mental health support
  • Work-Life Balance: PTO, paid holidays, flexible work arrangements
  • Financial Wellness: Competitive salary, 403(b) with company match
  • Professional Development: Ongoing training, tuition reimbursement, and career advancement paths
  • Additional Perks: Wellness programs, commuter benefits, and a vibrant company culture

Job Purpose

Under the supervision of the Principal Investigator and site Project Manager, the Research Assistant will conduct interviews and assessments and administer questionnaires; conducting outreach, education, and engagement activities to identify and recruit study participants; collect, gather, or organize data from different sources (including, for example, electronic medical records or public or other data sources); maintain research databases and files; perform or assist in literature searches; perform general administrative tasks; participate with the research team in conducting basic data analyses and preparing reports, including progress reports and provide recovery guiding. This specific position will involve supporting clinical trials and clinical demonstration projects, other clinical research and program development activities, and will work closely with other team members including addiction medicine specialists who will prescribe medications to treat opioid use disorder in the Department of Psychiatry and Behavioral Sciences.

Supervisory Authority

No direct reports but, may provide technical supervision to junior staff or students.

Nature And Scope

Interact with patients, families, University and Hospital staff, community-based organizations and the general public.

Principal Accountabilities

  • Recruits participants into research studies; assesses potential participants for eligibility; enrolls study participants, including explaining research procedures & protocols and obtaining informed consent of subjects and/or their families.
  • Responsible for a) recruiting study participants; b) tracking and maintaining contact with study participants after enrollment; and c) maintaining high rates of retention in research follow-up assessments.
  • Schedules appointments of study participants; contacts participants to remind them about appointments.
  • Participates in and successfully completes clinical research and IRB training requirements.
  • Assist in the submission of IRB applications.
  • Administers questionnaires, conducts interviews and assessments following established protocols, and assists study participants in navigating through questionnaires.
  • Performs a variety of data management procedures (e.g., data entry, producing basic reports, data cleaning, database maintenance).
  • Use active learning approaches to engage participants in learning about opioid use disorder (OUD), Medication for Opioid Use Disorder (MOUD) with buprenorphine, the role of MOUD in treatment and recovery, and the role of behavioral change in recovery.
  • Codes qualitative interviews using codebooks and NVIVO database. Utilizes databases (e.g., Excel) to track research activities and to record data.
  • Aids in the development of reports, grants, presentations, and data analysis. Assists with manuscript and grant preparation and research.
  • Engages in outreach, education, and participant recruitment activities at community and social service agencies, such as food distribution sites, needle and syringe exchange programs, health clinics, hospital emergency departments, and health fairs or other community events.
  • Maintains logs of and documents outreach, engagement, recruitment, and follow-up activities.
  • Monitor with the participant the participant’s progress implementing the plans and achieving the objectives and work with the participant to revise the plans as needed to increase success in accomplishing the objectives.
  • Attends all required training and meetings of the research team, as instructed by Principal Investigator or Project Manager.
  • Provide manual-guided individual counseling (Recovery Guiding) to participants.
  • Participate in and successfully complete initial training and certification, including workshops and provision of Recovery Guiding under close supervision.
  • Meets regularly with study team to track and manage community outreach, engagement, recruitment, and follow-up activities and to address recruitment and data retention issues.
  • May be assigned to attend local or national meetings and conferences to discuss peer outreach activities recovery guiding and disseminate research results.
  • Understands and adheres to confidentiality and privacy protections for persons with opioid or other substance use and for study participants and maintains appropriate professional boundaries.
  • Maintains established departmental policies and procedures, objectives, quality assurance programs, safety, environmental and infection control standards. Participates in staff meetings/initiatives including appropriate quality improvement and education activities, or if unable to attend non-mandatory activities, accepts responsibility to review meeting minutes and becomes knowledgeable of issues discussed.
  • Conforms to College of Medicine and hospital standards of performance and conduct, including those pertaining to patient rights, so that the best possible service and patient care may be provided.
  • Other duties as assigned.

Core Competencies

  • Professional demeanor, excellent communication and interpersonal skills, attention to detail, reliability, and ability to work independently and as part of a team.
  • Must have the ability to take initiative and handle multiple priorities and tasks. Ability to communicate effectively (listen and build trust) and interact with respect and nonjudgmentally with people of different genders, sexual orientation, socio-economic status, ethnic, language and cultural backgrounds.
  • Ability to work collaboratively with multi-disciplinary team to manage community engagement recruitment and other project tasks.
  • Comfortable about and capable of going to, working in, and engaging and recruiting for participation in the study people with untreated opioid use disorder in a broad variety of community settings and locations, including high drug use areas.
  • Proficiency with Microsoft Office applications (i.e., MS Word, Excel, Access, PowerPoint, Outlook) and web browsers. Experience with database management tools and statistical software (e.g., NVIVO, SPSS, SAS) is a plus.
  • Coursework in data collection and research methodology.
  • Must successfully complete training in human participant research certification.

Minimum Requirements

A bachelor’s or master’s degree is preferred, along with 1–3 years of research experience. Experience conducting research in behavioral health (addiction or mental health), public health, and/or clinical study settings is preferred.

Compliance Salary Range Disclosure

$50,000-$60,000

title: Technical Account Engineering / Customer Solutions (Renewable Energy)
description:
Overview

Our client is a leading international industrial group specialized in biogas and biomethane valorization solutions. With one of the largest installed bases of operational units worldwide, the company designs, manufactures, and deploys modular, containerized, and industrialized systems recognized for their high performance, reliability, and technological maturity. Its solutions serve industrial agribusiness groups, energy players, and environmental operators across global markets.

As part of its long-term development strategy in Brazil, the company is strengthening its local organization and is looking for a Technical Account Engineer to support project execution and client management, while contributing to the structuring and growth of its Brazilian operations.

The position is remote, based in Brazil (Curitiba, São Paulo State or Rio de Janeiro) , with frequent travel across the country and occasional international trips.

Missions

Reporting to the International Sales Manager (LATAM) and working closely with European engineering teams, you will support the execution of biogas and biomethane projects in Brazil, acting as the local technical and operational reference for clients.

  • You will manage and follow up projects from a technical standpoint, coordinating interfaces between headquarters engineering teams, local Brazilian subcontractors, and industrial end customers to ensure smooth project execution.
  • You will oversee the implementation of modular and containerized biogas upgrading systems (drying, filtration, compression, integrated units), supporting technical clarification phases and contributing to successful delivery.
  • You will act as the Responsible Engineer (Engenheiro Responsável) for the company in Brazil, ensuring compliance with CREA requirements and local engineering regulations, and interfacing with local authorities when required.
  • You will represent the company in technical meetings, site visits, and project reviews, building trusted relationships with industrial stakeholders and providing structured reporting and feedback to international headquarters.
  • While not responsible for active prospecting, you will demonstrate strong client orientation and commercial awareness , contributing to long-term customer satisfaction and repeat business.

Profile

You hold a Brazilian engineering degree (Mechanical, Electrical, Chemical / Process, Energy, Environmental Engineering, among others) and have initial professional experience (2 to 4 years) in an industrial, infrastructure, or energy-related environment.

title: Senior Site Reliability / Gitops Engineer
description:
Canonical is a leading provider of open source software and operating systems to the global enterprise and technology markets. Our platform, Ubuntu, is very widely used in breakthrough enterprise initiatives such as public cloud, data science, AI, engineering innovation, and IoT. Our customers include the world's leading public cloud and silicon providers, and industry leaders in many sectors. The company is a pioneer of global distributed collaboration, with 1200+ colleagues in 75+ countries and very few office-based roles. Teams meet two to four times yearly in person, in interesting locations around the world, to align on strategy and execution. The company is founder-led, profitable, and growing.

We are hiring a Senior Site Reliability / Gitops Engineer to our Information Systems (IS) team. This role is an opportunity for an "automation-first" senior technologist with a passion for Linux to build a career with Canonical and drive the success with those leveraging Ubuntu and open source products. If you have experience of IT operations automation, Infrastructure as Code and a passion for technology, then you will enjoy working with some of the best people in the industry at Canonical.

Job Summary

The IS team at Canonical supports and maintains all of Canonical's IT production services. The team is in charge of running services used by over 60 million Ubuntu users.

Responsibilities

  • Drive the development of automation, Gitops in your team as an embedded tech lead
  • Closely collaborate with the IS architect to align your solutions with the IS architecture vision
  • Design and architect services that IS can offer to the organization as products
  • Apply your experience of IaC to develop infrastructure as code practice within IS by constantly increasing automation and improving IaC processes
  • Automate software operations for re-usability and consistency across private and public clouds, taking into consideration the complexities of distributed systems
  • Maintain operational responsibility for all of Canonical's core services, networks, and infrastructure
  • Develop skills in troubleshooting, capacity planning, and performance investigation, setting up, maintaining and using observability tools such as Prometheus, Grafana, and Elasticsearch; design, implement and maintain monitoring and alerting for various systems and services
  • Provide assistance and work with globally distributed engineering, operations, and support peers
  • Be given uninterrupted development time to focus on larger projects and automation of manual tasks
  • Share your experience, know-how and best practices with other team members in design sessions, mentorship and 'doing work together'
  • Carry final responsibility for time-critical escalations

What we are looking for in you

  • A modern view on hosting architecture, driven by infrastructure as code across both private and public clouds.
  • A product mindset thriving to develop products rather than solutions.
  • Python software development experience, with large projects
  • Experience working with Kubernetes or other container orchestration systems.
  • Proven exposure to manage and deploy cloud infrastructure with code.
  • Practical knowledge of Linux networking, routing, and firewalls
  • Affinity with various forms of Linux storage, from Ceph to Databases
  • Hands-on experience administering enterprise Linux servers
  • Extensive knowledge of cloud computing concepts and technologies
  • Bachelor's degree or greater, preferably in computer science or related engineering field
  • Able to communicate clearly and effectively in English over email, chat, video or voice calls and in-person
  • Motivated and able to troubleshoot from kernel to web, and willing to ask others when appropriate
  • A willingness to be flexible and able to learn new things quickly
  • Be inspired by the needs of fast-changing environments
  • Happy to work within distributed teams
  • Be passionate and familiarized about open-source, especially Ubuntu or Debian

What we offer colleagues

We consider geographical location, experience, and performance in shaping compensation worldwide. We revisit compensation annually (and more often for graduates and associates) to ensure we recognize outstanding performance. In addition to base pay, we offer a performance-driven annual bonus or commission. We provide all team members with additional benefits which reflect our values and ideals. We balance our programs to meet local needs and ensure fairness globally.

  • Distributed work environment with twice-yearly team sprints in person
  • Personal learning and development budget of USD 2,000 per year
  • Annual compensation review
  • Recognition rewards
  • Annual holiday leave
  • Maternity and paternity leave
  • Team Member Assistance Program & Wellness Platform
  • Opportunity to travel to new locations to meet colleagues
  • Priority Pass and travel upgrades for long-haul company events

About Canonical

Canonical is a pioneering tech firm at the forefront of the global move to open source. As the company that publishes Ubuntu, one of the most important open-source projects and the platform for AI, IoT, and the cloud, we are changing the world of software. We recruit on a global basis and set a very high standard for people joining the company. We expect excellence; in order to succeed, we need to be the best at what we do. Most colleagues at Canonical have worked from home since our inception in 2004. Working here is a step into the future and will challenge you to think differently, work smarter, learn new skills, and raise your game.

We are proud to foster a workplace free from discrimination. Diversity of experience, perspectives, and background create a better work environment and better products. Whatever your identity, we will give your application fair consideration.

The Senior Front-End Engineer is responsible for creating clean, efficient, standards compliant HTML, CSS, and JavaScript across a wide range of web sites and web applications. The Senior Front End handles the most complex tasks alongside the Lead. Seniors are expected to need very little to no help when working on a large/complex module or problem. Responsibilities

  • Stay current with emerging technologies and tools, including advancements in AI-assisted development, and evaluate their relevance to team productivity and project quality.
  • Be able to manage multiple projects and responsibilities in a fast-paced environment.
  • Write the majority of HTML, CSS, and JavaScript on a project based on prototypes, designs, and functional documentation.
  • Work closely with the Front-End Lead/Architect to understand project needs and learn new development technologies.

  • Experience developing large web sites and web applications.
  • Experience building headless architectures
  • Maintain and fix bugs across multiple projects as well as ensure that standards are being kept throughout the front-end code.

  • Perform smoke tests on various devices and browsers.

Qualifications

  • 5+ years in similar roles

  • Agency experience
  • Expert knowledge of JavaScript, HTML5, CSS3
  • Experience with SASS, SCSS

  • Experience with source control systems (GIT)

  • Experience with cloud services (Azure, AWS, Google Cloud)

  • Strong collaboration skills and desire to work in a highly collaborative environment.
  • Effective interpersonal and communication skills (written, verbal and listening)
  • Good judgment, strong problem-solving and decision-making skills, and a finely tuned balance of technical purity and pragmatism.
  • Knowledge of common code design patterns, design principles and industry best practices.
  • Remain up to date with industry trends and technologies and be able to apply this knowledge to project work.

Nice to Have

  • GraphQL
  • Tailwind and/or Bootstrap experience
  • NextJS
  • NodeJS
  • Platform expertise: XMCloud, WordPress, Webflow, Opti SaaS.

Ten Great Reasons to Work at Verndale

  • We are relentlessly curious and enthusiastically solve our clients’ complex business problems through technology, data, and design.

Nosso propósito e valores

Atitude de dono, História de transformação, Relações duradouras e Ser presente.

Na MAG temos o forte propósito de oferecer soluções financeiras nos diversos momentos de vida de todos os brasileiros.   • Trabalhar de forma integrada com áreas de Remuneração, RH, Engenharia de Dados e BI, conectando necessidades analíticas a dados estruturados.
  • Contribuir para a automação e melhoria dos processos analíticos, reduzindo esforço manual e aumentando a confiabilidade.
  • Garantir boas práticas de uso de dados, respeitando diretrizes de governança, segurança da informação e LGPD.

title: Estágio em Redes Sociais - Futebol BR
description:
O que nos move?

Claro, a paixão por esportes é indiscutível, mas também somos grandes amantes de inovação constante! Buscamos soluções digitais que conectem clubes, federações, ligas e marcas ao público de forma eficaz e inovadora. Nosso objetivo é construir um ecossistema que sustente o esporte nas próximas décadas, integrando o melhor do digital e da TV. É assim que estamos fazendo história e queremos encontrar mais pessoas que acreditem no potencial do que estamos construindo e queiram fazer parte disso.

Como Estágio de Redes Sociais - Futebol BR

Sua missão será criar e adaptar conteúdos que traduzam o espírito olímpico em formatos digitais com a cara da CazéTV, leves, autênticos, conectados e cheios de personalidade. Você vai fortalecer nossa presença nas redes sociais trazendo ideias, recortes e conversas que aproximem ainda mais o público da nossa comunidade, ajudando a construir conteúdos que conectem esporte, audiência e marca do jeitinho que a gente gosta: verdadeiro, direto e com paixão pelo jogo . Tudo isso impulsionando não apenas nossa atuação no mercado, mas também a forma como o esporte é vivido, sentido e celebrado todos os dias.

Responsabilidades

  • Produção de Conteúdo: Publicar artes e vídeos para redes sociais de notícias dos atletas e das modalidades olímpicas.
  • Edição Ágil: Utilizar ferramentas de edição para criar artes e vídeos para publicação, garantindo eficiência e qualidade no fluxo diário.
  • Cobertura em Tempo Real: acompanhar competições e transmissões da CazéTV (jogos e programas), assegurando agilidade.
  • Monitoramento e Tendências: Observar movimentos das plataformas, identificar formatos emergentes e sugerir ideias que mantenham a LiveMode na vanguarda do conteúdo esportivo.
  • Colaboração Multidisciplinar: Trabalhar junto ao time de transmissões, design e audiovisual para fortalecer aplicações.
  • Apoio Operacional: Auxiliar no calendário de postagem e na promoção de eventos da CazéTV.

Requisitos Necessários

  • Matrícula ativa em curso superior: Base acadêmica que apoia o desenvolvimento técnico e profissional na área.
  • Previsão de formatura entre 12/2026 e 12/2027: Garantindo tempo adequado de evolução dentro do programa de estágio.
  • Disponibilidade para estagiar 30h semanais: Essencial para acompanhar o ritmo dinâmico da área.
  • Disponibilidade para trabalhar presencialmente: Importante para integração com o time e ritmo colaborativo.
  • Ser heavy user de redes sociais e apaixonado(a) por esportes, especialmente os olímpicos: Competência fundamental para criar conteúdo relevante e conectado com a comunidade.
  • Noções básicas de edição de imagem e vídeo: Habilidade técnica necessária para atuar com autonomia no fluxo diário de produção.

Diferenciais Desejáveis

  • Experiência prévia criando conteúdo digital: Mesmo em projetos pessoais ou acadêmicos, mostra iniciativa e familiaridade com o formato.
  • Interesse por inovação e novas tecnologias na produção de conteúdo: Agrega valor ao time e abre espaço para experimentação.
  • Inglês intermediário: Facilita acesso a referências, pesquisas e cobertura internacional.

Bolsa auxílio

R$ 1.800,00 por mês.

Nossos Benefícios

  • Auxílio Alimentação de R$ 1.250,00 por mês, para utilização em restaurantes, mercados, aplicativos de comida e estabelecimentos físicos ou online.
  • Vale Transporte (opcional) proporcional à quantidade de deslocamentos utilizados por dia, sem desconto no valor da bolsa.
  • Plano de Saúde (SulAmérica Vital) com cobertura nacional e acomodação em apartamento, incluindo consultas, exames, pronto-socorro, cirurgias, internações hospitalares, partos e outros serviços. Não há coparticipação para estagiários. Sem possibilidade de adicionar dependentes.
  • Plano Odontológico (Mais DOC) sem custos de coparticipação para os estagiários. Sem possibilidade de adicionar dependentes.
  • TotalPass e Wellhub (opcionais) o estagiário pode escolher a plataforma que melhor atender às suas necessidades. Ambas oferecem acesso a academias de diversas modalidades, esportes variados e aplicativos de saúde física, mental e financeira.
  • Seguro de Vida é uma proteção financeira para o estagiário e seus beneficiários em momentos de adversidade.
  • SESC oferece acesso a atividades culturais, esportivas, de lazer, saúde e educação, incentivando um estilo de vida saudável e equilibrado.
  • Open English oferece acesso a cursos de inglês ou espanhol em diversos formatos, com descontos exclusivos para estagiários e familiares.

Nossa Cultura

Na LiveMode, nossa missão é Transformar e Crescer o Esporte , e nossos valores são o combustível que nos move no dia a dia. Acreditamos que crescer exige inconformismo, ambição e consistência. Nossa cultura nasce disso: de gente que não aceita o que está aí, que quer fazer mais, aprender mais e entregar mais — sempre com responsabilidade e visão de futuro. Quem está na LiveMode está aqui para marcar a história do esporte no Brasil e no Mundo.

SOMOS EMPREENDEDORES

ontem, hoje e sempre. Escolhemos o gol e corremos atrás dele com tudo. Focamos em poucas prioridades e vamos até o fim, sem distrações. Tratamos cada recurso como se fosse nosso, decidindo rápido e com coragem. Comunicação? Direta, aberta e na velocidade do jogo.

SOMOS UM TIME DE ALTA PERFORMANCE

não uma família ou uma confraria de amigos. Família a gente não escolhe, mas o time escolhe quem joga. E quando o jogo é grande, não dá pra carregar quem não tá entregando. Aqui, a gente decide pelo que é melhor pra empresa, não pra uma área ou pessoa. Toda entrega tem um dono claro, que vai até o fim. Processos ajudam, mas não mandam: quem resolve são as pessoas.

SOMOS AMBICIOSOS

pensamos sempre grande. A gente já fez muita coisa grande. Mas quem está na LiveMode sabe que dá pra ir além. Porque quem é ambicioso de verdade vive com a sensação de que sempre dá pra melhorar, crescer, fazer mais impacto. Aqui, a ambição não é discurso. É prática. E é ela que nos leva a quebrar recorde atrás de recorde.

O QUE NOS MOVE É O FUTURO

Na LiveMode, o futuro já está em movimento — e quem não acompanha, fica pra trás. Por isso, tratamos tecnologia com urgência: testamos, aprendemos e aplicamos com velocidade. Queremos ser uma empresa IA first, porque acreditamos que dominar essas ferramentas não é opcional — é o que vai nos ajudar a alcançar nossa missão mais rápido. IA não é extra. É parte central do nosso dia a dia.

description:
Descrição da vaga

Na RD Saúde , você é o primeiro sorriso que acolhe, garantindo uma experiência única para cada cliente.

Aqui, você tem a oportunidade de unir atendimento humanizado, empatia e propósito em um ambiente que valoriza seu desenvolvimento e crescimento.

Somos líderes no mercado brasileiro de farmácias, com lojas em todo o país e mais de 60 mil pessoas apaixonadas por cuidar de gente . Trilhamos um caminho de desenvolvimento que impulsiona carreiras e transforma futuros. Juntos por uma sociedade de mais saudável impactamos mais de 1 milhão de vidas e queremos ir ainda mais longe — de forma sólida, humana e lado a lado com você. Venha fazer parte dessa jornada e trilhar um caminho que transforma carreiras e futuros.

#Seja RD Saúde e venha transformar vidas com a gente!

Informações adicionais

O que oferecemos?

Trilha de Carreira: 100% dos(as) gerentes da RD Saúde vieram de cargos de entrada – atendentes e farmacêuticos(as). Demais, né? O melhor é que essa jornada da entrada até a liderança dura em média apenas 2 anos e 6 meses. Ah, e você sabia que ajudamos com a Graduação para farmacêutico? Sim, pois aqui, seu crescimento e desenvolvimento importam.

  • Local de trabalho: Farmácia (Loja)
  • Escala de trabalho: 5x2 – com folgas (2 dias seguidas) no ciclo de 6 semanas

Porque ser RD Saúde?

  • Estamos em mais de 600 municípios com forte presença nacional;
  • Estamos em todos os estados do Brasil;
  • Estamos entre as marcas mais admiradas do Brasil;
  • 100% das unidades abastecidas com energia renovável;
  • Trilhas de capacitação e desenvolvimento para todas as funções;
  • Levamos a sério e com respeito a Diversidade e a Inclusão;
  • Nosso impacto social tem propósito de juntos por uma sociedade mais saudável.

São mais de 40 benefícios pensados pra você e pra sua família.

  • Programa de Participação nos Resultados;
  • Trilha de carreira;
  • Convênio com empresas parceiras;
  • Graduação em Farmácia;
  • Vale transporte;

  • kit bebê para mamães na RD Saúde;
  • Vale presente de aniversário

Juntos por uma sociedade mais saudável

Somos RD Saúde, um ecossistema de saúde integral, com mais de 3 mil unidades em todo o Brasil e negócios em saúde que dividem o mesmo propósito: contribuir para uma sociedade mais saudável. Nossa jornada começou em novembro de 2011, fruto da união entre Raia e Drogasil, crescendo até se tornar a maior rede de farmácias do Brasil e expandindo para além do varejo farmacêutico, integrando soluções B2B e plataformas digitais.

Com mais de um milhão de vidas atendidas diariamente em todo o país, cuidar de perto dos(as) nossos(as) clientes e das nossas pessoas está em nosso DNA. Somos mais de 57 mil profissionais comprometidos em construir o futuro da saúde com calor humano e tecnologia. title: Terapeuta Ocupacional - Duque de Caxias, RJ
description:
Visão Geral

Transformar vidas com saúde é o que nos move! Atuamos em todo o Brasil por meio de duas unidades de negócios, Amil e Rede Total Care, com mais de 1.500 hospitais credenciados e uma rede própria de hospitais, clínicas, centros de tratamento, home care e transporte médico. Com uma missão clara e valores sólidos, fortalecemos nossa cultura com compromisso de servir sempre melhor. Cuidamos das nossas pessoas colaboradoras para que esse cuidado se reflita na população que atendemos. Promovemos uma cultura inovadora, diversa, equitativa e inclusiva. Todas as candidaturas qualificadas são bem-vindas, sem distinção de etnia, raça, deficiência, orientação sexual, identidade ou expressão de gênero, idade, nacionalidade, religião ou qualquer outro marcador social. Reforçamos Que Não Solicitamos Pagamentos, Taxas Ou Códigos SMS Em Nossos Processos Seletivos. Todas As Oportunidades Estão Disponíveis Em Nossos Canais Oficiais e No Nosso Site De Carreira. Qualquer Situação Diferente Deve Ser Denunciada.

Principais Responsabilidades

  • Realizar avaliação nos aspectos sensório-motores e cognitivos a fim de identificar limitações na funcionalidade e desempenho ocupacional nas atividades de auto cuidado, instrumentais da vida diária e de vida prática registrando os dados no formulário "Avaliação de Terapia Ocupacional" que deve ser impressa, assinada e constar nº do registro profissional;
  • Estabelecer objetivos do tratamento terapêutico ocupacional e data de reavaliação a fim de verificar se os objetivos propostos inicialmente foram alcançados e estabelecer a frequência dos atendimentos;
  • Consultar os registros do prontuário, pelo menos das últimas 24 horas antes de iniciar o atendimento do paciente, para compreender melhor o caso e assim ter condições de prestar uma assistência mais adequada;
  • Registrar no prontuário a evolução, após o atendimento do paciente, a fim de documentar a avaliação diária, conduta realizada, resposta do paciente à terapia, alterações de objetivos do tratamento e programação de novas condutas (se necessário), discussões com a equipe multidisciplinar e orientações fornecidas aos pacientes e seus familiares. A qualidade do registro em prontuário irá contribuir para garantir o acesso às informações do paciente e a continuidade do cuidado;
  • Indicar e orientar o uso de equipamento adaptativo e / ou tecnologia assistiva, a fim de facilitar o ganho funcional do paciente, incremento da independência e ganho de qualidade de vida;
  • Orientar e indicar adaptação de órtese bem como mudanças do estilo de vida, com orientação para manejo do tempo e conservação de energia;
  • Verificar a necessidade e escolher apropriadamente os recursos terapêuticos que serão utilizados para o atendimento ao paciente, preferencialmente antes do iniciar o atendimento, com intuito de antecipar as demandas visando prestar uma assistência completa;
  • Monitorar constantemente todos os pacientes em acompanhamento da terapia ocupacional observando a evolução clínica e necessidade de intervenções, a fim de planejar melhor a assistência ao paciente;
  • Orientar pacientes e familiares quanto ao tratamento proposto e seus objetivos durante a internação e na alta, com consequente, orientação domiciliar;
  • Preencher a estatística de pacientes atendidos diariamente com objetivo de controle do número atendimentos realizados;
  • Conversar com familiares, pelo menos uma vez ao dia, a fim de explicar os objetivos do acompanhamento da terapia ocupacional e dar oportunidade para esclarecimento de dúvidas;
  • Seguir normas e rotinas estabelecidas pelo SCIH (Serviço de Controle de Infecções Hospitalar), consultando os documentos disponíveis no sistema GED (Gerenciador de Documentos) e participando dos treinamentos, com o intuito de aplicar as ações e contribuir para a prevenção de infecções hospitalares;
  • Prestar assistência nas unidades de internação quando houver necessidade da Instituição (por exemplo, diminuição do nº de pacientes que precisam da assistência de fisioterapia na UTI);
  • Consultar e-mail corporativo diariamente;
  • Informar a supervisão a respeito de queixas de pacientes/familiares ou problemas gerais;
  • Executar atividades relacionadas aos processos da área, conforme designado pelos líderes imediatos ou de acordo com a necessidade da área;
  • Cumprir e respeitar as normas e regras instituídas pela empresa, bem como as regras dos órgãos certificadores adotados por esta instituição.

Qualificações Necessárias

  • Ensino Superior Completo em Terapia Ocupacional;
  • Conselho de Classe e Anuidade 2025 em dia;
  • Vivência anterior de pelo menos 1 ano em ambiente hospitalar ou ambulatorial, de acordo com o setor de trabalho;
  • Conhecimento intermediário do idioma Inglês;
  • Pacote Office: Word, Excel, Power Point, Outlook, básico ou intermediário;
  • Cursos de aprimoramento ou atualização nas áreas assistenciais;
  • Desejável curso de Suporte Básico de Vida (BLS) ou similar;
  • Disponibilidade para atuar de Segunda à Sexta de 8 às 14 na região de Duque de Caxias.

Palavras-Chave: Grupo Amil, Terapia Ocupacional, Terapeuta, Ambulatorial, Hospitalar, PCD, Pessoas com Deficiência, Duque de Caxias, Rio de Janeiro, RJ.

#J-18808-Ljbffr

title: Promotor de Vendas Externas - Campo Grande
description:
SegMedic é uma empresa de assistência à saúde cuja missão é cuidar das pessoas, oferecendo um excelente serviço de atendimento ambulatorial. A empresa possui unidades localizadas em Nova Iguaçu, Nilópolis, São João de Meriti e Campo Grande (RJ), atendendo toda Baixada Fluminense e a zona oeste do Rio, com mais de 25 especialidades médicas e 3.000 tipos de exames complementares e laboratoriais. Buscamos profissionais que tenham o objetivo de impactar o mundo positivamente. Estamos ansiosos para conhecê-lo(a) e contar com sua contribuição em nossa equipe.

ESTAMOS À PROCURA DE PROMOTOR DE VENDAS EXTERNAS

Estamos em busca de Assistentes de Atendimento proativos e orientados a resultados. Você atuará em todas as fases do ciclo de vida do cliente , da prospecção à retenção. Se você se identifica com o desafio de garantir uma jornada de excelência, transformando interessados em clientes fiéis, queremos te conhecer.

O que você vai fazer

Atrair e vender

  • Atuar no formato externo
  • Atender e orientar clientes por telefone, WhatsApp e pessoalmente
  • Procurar novos clientes de forma ativa e simpática, em ações externas e nas áreas próximas às unidades de trabalho
  • Acompanhar o cliente desde o primeiro contato até o fechamento
  • Mostrar aos clientes a importância de cuidar da saúde de forma contínua

Atender e manter o relacionamento

  • Agendar consultas e exames, ajudando a organizar as agendas (confirmar consultas, gerenciar cancelamentos e encaixes)
  • Manter todas as informações dos clientes atualizadas no sistema
  • Entrar em contato com o cliente após o atendimento para saber se ele ficou satisfeito
  • Comunicar aos clientes sobre novas promoções e serviços

Competências que você precisa ter

  • Comunicação: Saber se comunicar de forma clara, para que os clientes se sintam bem recebidos e informados
  • Habilidade de Vendas: Gostar de convencer as pessoas e ter facilidade para negociar e fechar negócios
  • Foco no Cliente: Saber ouvir e ter empatia, se colocando no lugar do cliente para resolver problemas e superar as expectativas
  • Proatividade: Ter iniciativa para identificar desafios e oportunidades, agindo rapidamente para buscar soluções
  • Organização: Ser uma pessoa organizada e precisa, capaz de gerenciar várias tarefas ao mesmo tempo e seguir as rotinas diárias com rigor
  • Vontade de Aprender: Ter interesse genuíno em ajudar e aprender, buscando sempre se aprimorar e conhecer mais sobre os serviços
  • Trabalho em Equipe: Gostar de colaborar e se relacionar bem com as pessoas para garantir que tudo funcione de forma harmoniosa no dia a dia

Benefícios

  • Sesc
  • TotalPass
  • Benefício em farmácias
  • Assistente médica (rede própria)
  • Vale Refeição/Alimentação no valor de R$22,00 por dia trabalhado (+6h)

Informações Adicionais

  • Vale Transporte
  • Local: Campo Grande
  • Jornada de trabalho CLT: Escala 6x1 | 44h semanais | 220h mensais
  • Vaga disponível também para candidatos PCD

title: RESERVOIR ENGINEERING
description:
Job Description

Founded in 2014, EP2C ENERGY is a fast‑growing technical assistance and engineering consulting company operating in the fields of Energy (Renewable Energies, Oil & Gas, Nuclear), Life Sciences (Pharmaceutical, Cosmetics and Agri‑food industries), and Large Industrial Construction Projects (Mining, Construction, Water Treatment, Petrochemicals and Chemicals).

Our international footprint, with subsidiaries in Latin America, Africa and Asia, enables us to work alongside major players in our sectors while offering real career development opportunities to our employees, both in France and worldwide.

As a human‑sized company, we are committed to supporting and developing our employees, who are recognized and valued for their expertise and know‑how.

Joining EP2C Energy means taking part in an ambitious and rewarding journey.

To strengthen our teams and support our continued growth, we are currently looking for a Reservoir Engineer (M/F) in Rio de Janeiro.

Key Responsibilities

  • Validate collected reservoir data (mainly dynamic data), and integration into reservoir databases.
  • Perform dynamic data interpretation and synthesis to update field’s subsurface understanding.
  • Evaluate the main subsurface uncertainties, and account for their impact in reserves and production profiles evaluations.
  • Identify required model revisions and updates. Contribute to reservoir model new‑built and modifications (dynamic part). Ensure adequacy of reservoir models and other evaluation tools for production forecasting, reserves evaluations and uncertainties analysis.
  • Follow‑up geosciences and reservoir studies and projects carried out at head‑quarter. Contribute necessary data exchanges with HQ.
  • Develop own skills in Reservoir Engineering and Simulation by keeping close contact with specialist staff in the affiliate and HQ entities.
  • Ensure integration with other geosciences disciplines and senior geosciences integrators.
  • Apply Company dedicated rules for ensuring geosciences patrimonial data protection.
  • Provide adequate tools and methodology to the Assets for influencing the operator on field management and development.
  • Perform the necessary reservoir engineering interpretation and synthesis studies to improve subsurface understanding and model predictability.
  • Participate in building and updating the affiliate’s subsurface databases.

Profile Required

  • Background: Master in Reservoir/Petroleum Engineering
  • Knowledge in pre‑salt reservoirs and context
  • Professional exposure: 3‑8 years of experience (preferably with an operator)
  • Technical skills: Reservoir simulation software (Eclipse/IX); Reservoir interpretation software (PETEX suite, Kappa Saphir, OFM…); and subsurface databases.

Commitments

EP2C Energy is committed to diversity and inclusion and encourages applications from individuals with disabilities.

As part of our Quality, Health, Safety and Environment (QHSE) policy, strict compliance with QHSE rules is essential to ensure a safe working environment and to contribute positively to environmental protection. By joining our teams, you will be required to follow HSE procedures and best practices, while actively contributing to the continuous improvement of our processes.

  • Garantir a adoção consistente de metodologias ativas, andragogia e formatos híbridos de aprendizagem, acompanhando programas síncronos, assíncronos e presenciais com foco em aplicação prática e engajamento.
  • Monitorar a efetividade das trilhas e programas sob a ótica do negócio, utilizando indicadores, dados e feedbacks para ajustes contínuos e tomada de decisão.

O que esperamos de você:

  • Visão estratégica de negócio aplicada à educação corporativa.
  • Capacidade comprovada de priorização, planejamento e tomada de decisão com base em objetivos de negócio.
